subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is DeepSeek, the small blue-haired, blue-eyed child in the four-view character sheet <Picture 1>. The front, two side and rear views depict one character, not four people; do not copy the neutral pose or sheet layout. Preserve her round face, baby proportions, whale hat and blue outfit. The same character appears in <Picture 3>, <Picture 5> and <Picture 6>; these images guide staging, not a replacement identity.
<Subject 2> is Claude in the four-view character sheet <Picture 2>; its four angles depict one character, with orange hair, amber eyes, an embroidered white dress, an orange flower on her own left temple and an ivory veil.
<Subject 3> is the sunlit Gothic market and black-and-gold-robed procession in <Picture 3> and <Picture 4>.
<Subject 4> is the metal bowl heaped with white rice, held by <Subject 1> in <Picture 3> and <Picture 5>, and shown closely in <Picture 6>. <Picture 1> contains no bowl.
<Picture 3> guides the wide composition of [Shot 1].
<Picture 4> guides the foreground framing of Claude in [Shot 2].
<Picture 5> guides the over-shoulder composition of [Shot 3], with the child on the left and Claude partly visible at the right edge.
<Picture 6> guides the bowl close-up of [Shot 4], including its position between the characters. These four pictures are composition references, not prescribed first frames or held slides.

[reference generation] A 15-second, four-shot animated encounter: <Subject 1> stops before the procession in <Subject 3>, meets the gaze of <Subject 2>, offers <Subject 4>, and waits without receiving a response. Eyeline cuts and a bowl-position match connect one continuous event. The child remains on the left of Claude; all cameras stay on the same side of their interaction axis.

<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - identity and clothing follow the four-view character sheet; in [Shot 4], only her hands and partial body are visible.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - identity and left-side flower remain consistent; only a shoulder or cropped hair and dress are visible in the last two shots.
<Subject 3> (appears in all four shots): fully_preserved - market architecture, daylight and robe designs persist across the exchange.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - the same full bowl stays in the child's two hands.
<Picture 3> ([Shot 1] composition): fully_preserved - retain the low wide layout; animate the approach and stop.
<Picture 4> ([Shot 2] composition): fully_preserved - retain the enclosing foreground robes; animate Claude turning into the reference view.
<Picture 5> ([Shot 3] composition): fully_preserved - retain relative placement while the child lifts and extends the bowl once.
<Picture 6> ([Shot 4] composition): fully_preserved - retain the offered bowl, hand placement and unbridged gap. No image is imposed as an exact opening or ending frame.

detailed_description:
The video follows the supplied Gothic fantasy animation design, with warm market daylight and deep black robe foregrounds. Preserve the reference colors and render continuous character animation without captions or reference labels.
[Shot 1] A child-eye-level wide shot uses <Picture 3> to establish <Subject 3>. <Subject 1> walks briskly toward screen right, holding <Subject 4> steadily in both hands. The camera tracks laterally at her pace; stalls and near robes pass at different speeds. Her hat, hair and hem respond to each step. As robed figures cross her path, she slows and stops, and the camera eases to a stop with her. She raises her gaze toward someone to the right. Her footfalls cease while the procession's fabric remains audible.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, an eyeline cut reveals <Subject 2> in the medium close framing of <Picture 4>. She starts facing along the procession, then turns toward the footfalls that have just stopped, looking down toward screen left. The camera holds still as near robes drift past and her veil moves gently. Her eyes settle on the child and sustain the connection for a beat. Market ambience carries across the cut without restarting. She does not speak.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, a reverse eyeline cut places the camera beside Claude's shoulder, using <Picture 5>. <Subject 1> looks up at Claude, glances at <Subject 4>, then raises and extends it toward screen right. The camera pushes in slowly with small amplitude, keeping the child's face, bowl and Claude's cropped shoulder visible. Beginning around 9.8 seconds, the child, <Subject 1> (S1), speaks with an inviting emotion: <d>[Chinese] 你要吃一点吗？</d> She completes the sentence before the next cut. The bowl reaches the space between them; both hands retain their grip.
[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, cut to the close-up composition of <Picture 6>, matching the bowl's rim height, angle and hand positions from the previous shot. Continue the preceding gentle push briefly and ease to rest. The child does not lift or offer the bowl again. Steam rises above the rice during two seconds of waiting. Claude's dress and hair remain cropped at the right edge; no receiving hand enters. From 14 to 15 seconds, sustain this same state with breathing micro-movement and changing steam, without a new action or line.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous market murmur, footsteps and robe rustle connect the shots. The market recedes as the framing tightens; quiet sleeve movement accompanies the single offer. No additional intelligible crowd speech, repeated dialogue, impact sound or music is heard.

[Shot 1] Cut from the suspended bowl to the eye watching it; the same market ambience becomes muffled. Use <Picture 3> for composition. Claude remains in the procession's shadow, looking down toward DeepSeek. Only one eye fills the frame; the child's whale hat and offered bowl are tiny reflections, not separate physical figures. Her gratitude is heard while her mouth stays outside the frame. She does not smile or reach for the bowl. Hold a deliberate extreme close-up of one eye; the downward gaze and tiny reflection carry the action, without zooming into the pupil. Muffled market ambience; robe rustle approaches at the end. The bowl strike occurs only after the following cut. From 1.5 to 3 seconds, Claude (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 谢谢你。</d>.

A cultist steps between the child and Claude and strikes the bowl rim once. Rice scatters, but DeepSeek retains the opposite side of the bowl, recoiling with raised shoulders. Claude looks back anxiously behind the cultist. The child is forced toward the roadside with the emptied bowl still in her hands. At bowl height, make a short lateral follow of the striking hand, keeping the child and Claude behind her legible; settle on the retained bowl. One palm strike on metal, scattered rice and a short startled intake of breath.

Use <Picture 5> for composition. Seen from behind, DeepSeek holds the emptied bowl low at the church entrance. She listens to the offscreen cultist announcing Claude's sacrifice that night. After understanding the threat, she turns away, retaining the bowl. Claude remains inside and out of sight. Follow a short distance behind DeepSeek in a wide shot, then stop before the church door, preserving its depth. The announcement carries from inside across the steps. After its final words, the closing door suppresses the market sound; hurried steps lead onward. From 6.4 to 9.0722 seconds, the cultists (S2) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 今夜，为 Claude 行火祭。</d>.
[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, Cut forward a short distance to the roadside, matching the empty bowl and grip; she releases it only after it rests on the table. Use <Picture 6> for composition. DeepSeek sets the nearly empty bowl, with a few grains remaining, on a low roadside table. She looks anxiously toward the palace and runs to seek help with both hands empty. The bowl remains on the table. In a side medium shot, briefly pan with the bowl onto the low table, then tilt with the child's gaze toward the palace and let her run out of frame. A light bowl contact on the table, followed by departing running footsteps.

subject_definitions:

<Subject 2>: Claude, identity and outfit from four-view sheet <Picture 2>.

summary:

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - identity and outfit design.
<Subject 2>: fully_preserved - identity and outfit design.
<Picture 3>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.
<Picture 4>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
Claude keeps her own left-temple flower and ivory veil. During the church sequence she is barefoot; fire damage persists until departure. Clean clothes return only in the later market scene.
[Shot 1] Mark the time and location jump with night wind replacing the bell; the offscreen order motivates the cultists' departure. Use <Picture 3> for composition. DeepSeek hides beside an opening in the church side wall at night. Distant cultists carry lanterns toward the wood store after the offscreen order to fetch one log each. She waits until the final lantern disappears, then shifts to the same opening without entering yet. From the hiding place, retain both the wall opening and doorway, briefly pan with the last lantern, then reframe slightly for the child's move. The offscreen order is clear; footsteps recede under night wind and faint church flame sounds. From 0 to 3.8 seconds, the cultists (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 取乌烬木，一人一根。</d>.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, Cut inside the same opening to meet her entering head, preserving her direction of entry. Use <Picture 4> for composition. DeepSeek peeks through the low side-wall opening. A soft side fin of her whale hat catches on the protruding stone. She frowns and holds her breath while both small hands press the hat downward, trying to free it. At the end the fin is still caught, with her hands maintaining pressure. Hold a floor-level close-up inside the opening on the contact between the stone lip and hat fin; make only a small tilt to include both pressing hands. Stone dust and cloth scrape against the opening; only candle crackle is heard inside, without chanting.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, Cut on the sustained pressure; the fin comes free now, without another attempt to enter or get stuck. Use <Picture 5> for composition. The fin slips free under the same downward pressure, while the low ceiling still flattens the soft hat. DeepSeek squeezes her head and shoulders through that left-side wall opening, plants both hands on the church floor and drags her body inside. She has not yet stood or looked up. In a low side close-up, retreat a short distance as her head and shoulders enter, then stop when her body follows; keep the opening fixed. Continuous cloth and stone scraping, then a subdued landing sound as she comes through; the church remains free of chanting.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, Continue from the same landing into her crouch; her upward gaze motivates the reveal and the next cut to Claude. Use <Picture 6> for composition. DeepSeek is crouched inside the left-side wall opening on the lower floor. She looks up and sees Claude restrained on the highest altar at the top of the long stairway. She approaches the central stairs along the left-hand shadows and begins ascending at the end. The rear benches stay on the floor and the wall candles and high chandelier remain lit. Tilt up slowly from the crouched child in the left foreground into a wide reveal of the empty nave, long stairway and cross, then hold as she moves. A subdued landing thud, the nave's echo and candle crackle; no voices.
From 13 to 15 seconds, sustain the final state with natural micro-movement, without repeating actions or adding speech.

overall_soundscape:
Keep ambience and ongoing physical sounds continuous across cuts, following the shot-specific cues above. Dialogue appears only in its specified interval; do not add intelligible crowd speech. No generated music.

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
Claude keeps her own left-temple flower and ivory veil. During the church sequence she is barefoot; fire damage persists until departure. Clean clothes return only in the later market scene.
[Shot 1] Use an eyeline reverse of the child's upward look; the faint movement sound and candles retain the same empty church. Use <Picture 3> for composition. Claude hears the small sound from the side wall and looks down toward DeepSeek offscreen below. Surprise turns to concern, and she gently shakes her head to discourage the child from approaching. Her body remains restrained against the cross. Tilt slightly with Claude lowering her face, then hold the face-and-shoulder close-up for surprise and a restrained head shake. Candle crackle and faint breathing from the two characters; the hall stays quiet.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, Move from Claude's concerned downward look to the restraint detail, carrying the quiet without adding a new action against her. Use <Picture 4> for composition. Only Claude's bare feet, ankle chains and a cropped portion of her skirt are visible. Both feet stand on the small wooden footrest fixed to the cross's upright post. Each ankle is chained toward the post. Low piles of wood lie below on either side, without burying her toes or skirt. Make a short downward tilt from the ankles to the fixed footrest, ending on its clearance above the low wood piles. Soft candle crackle, faint breathing and a slight chain sound.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, Omit the stair climb across the cut and enter with the child already on the left of the cross; the question comes from their established facing positions. Use <Picture 5> for composition. DeepSeek has reached the level top platform beside the left side of the cross. Claude asks why she came; the child looks up and gives her promise. DeepSeek rises onto her toes and reaches both hands to the waist lock, ending with her grip established for the next attempt. All restraints remain fastened. Make a small lateral adjustment in a side two-shot on the platform, keeping the child, waist lock and Claude's face legible; tilt slightly with the reach. A few light steps, fabric movement and the empty hall's echo remain below the two lines; no chanting. From 5.1 to 6.7 seconds, Claude (S1) speaks with matching lip movement: <d>[Chinese] 你怎么来了？</d>. From 6.9 to 8.8 seconds, DeepSeek (S2) speaks with matching lip movement: <d>[Chinese] 我带你出去。</d>.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, Begin with both hands already on the clasp; only after it resists does she change her grip to the chain. Use <Picture 6> for composition. On tiptoe, DeepSeek tries to pry the waist lock, which does not move. She then grasps the chain across Claude's waist and pulls outward. It strikes the wooden cross once with a clear ring. Unable to open it, she adjusts her stance to continue trying; Claude remains upright and all five restraints remain closed. No cultists return yet. From the same side, follow the hands from the clasp to the waist chain, easing back to accommodate one pull and settling at its contact with the cross. One clear metallic chain strike and its echo, then quiet; no returning footsteps or cultist voices yet.
From 14 to 15 seconds, sustain the final state with natural micro-movement, without repeating actions or adding speech.

rows.title: 抓住第一根木头
rows.framing: 长阶下端侧面中景，双手抓住搬柴教徒的同一根木头
rows.camera: 阶下侧面中景短横移跟双手抓木，木头与教徒抱持姿态持续同框，不拍完整长阶冲刺。
rows.transition: 切镜省略宝宝下长阶，直接从阶下伸手抓木起；身后关门落闩声接队尾进入。
rows.action: 切入时小鱼已到长阶下端，刚才松开腰锁和冲下长阶的过程均已省略。她双手抓住一名教徒怀中同一根乌烬木伸出的端头，急切阻止他继续向上；教徒仍抱稳木头，队列继续前进。队尾教徒掩门落闩声从后方传来。此时没有手持火把。
rows.entry: 小鱼在高处开锁失败，看见抱柴队列。
rows.exit: 她抓牢一根木头，教徒仍要前进。
rows.effects: 下阶脚步、抓木摩擦与急喘，没有手持火焰声。
rows.note: 下长阶过程用切镜省略，本镜从阶下接抓木；不要2秒走完整长阶。
rows.execution: 下长阶过程剪辑省略，本镜从阶下抓木开始。

rows.title: 被推开，还想阻止
rows.framing: 阶下低机位近中景，撑地伸手与抱木离开者
rows.camera: 低位近中景随推开轻横摇并下俯到半跪，随后让抱木者越出前景，保留伸向木头的小手。
rows.transition: 同一根被抓木头与相同握持接前镜；教徒稳木后才用另一手推，不将木头变成击打工具。
rows.action: 教徒一臂抱稳木头，另一只手将小鱼推到一旁。她失去重心半跪撑地，另一只手仍朝被带走的木头伸着；更多黑袍从身边经过，踏上长阶。
rows.entry: 小鱼抓木阻拦。
rows.exit: 她撑地半跪，搬柴队伍没有停。
rows.effects: 衣料推擦、膝掌落地、木头与脚步不断。

rows.title: 一根接一根
rows.framing: 最高祭坛铺柴手部近景
rows.camera: 手部近景轻随一根木头下降，落定后向脚托短移揭示刚被遮住的边缘，不抬去拍脸。
rows.transition: 以抱木离去的运动方向接祭坛放木，省略搬运上阶路程，木头落响为动作切点。
rows.action: 祭坛上，一双黑金袍袖里的手把乌烬木横放下去。后一名教徒抱着下一根等在旁边。木头相继落下，先遮住固定脚托和脚踝，又沿白裙往上堆。
rows.entry: 教徒陆续登上最高祭坛。
rows.exit: 底柴累积成堆，固定脚托逐渐被遮住。
rows.cast_note: 教徒手部铺柴与Claude裙摆/脚托局部，不加脸部对白。
rows.effects: 厚木落堆闷响、树皮摩擦，落点清楚。

rows.title: 拦住下一个，又被踢开
rows.framing: 阶下侧面近中景，拦腿失败与抱木教徒同框
rows.camera: 回到阶下同侧中近景，随扑抱小腿短横移，再低摇跟滑倒；保持施力靴和宝宝在同一空间。
rows.transition: 从木头持续落响切回小鱼由半跪撑起，第二次阻拦是抱另一人的腿，不重演抓木。
rows.action: 小鱼撑起身，又扑向另一名搬柴教徒，抱住他的小腿。对方怀里仍抱着木头，用靴子将她拨踢到一旁；她滑倒在阶下，手还朝那条腿伸着。黑袍继续向上。
rows.entry: 小鱼从第一次推开中撑起，再拦另一人。
rows.exit: 她第二次倒下，队伍继续铺柴。
rows.effects: 靴底拨踢、衣料擦地、短促气声，不夸张重击。

rows.title: 柴堆吞没白裙
rows.framing: 最高祭坛低机位中景，黑木堆压满前景
rows.camera: 祭坛低位中景随最后一根木头小幅上摇，落定后停住呈现腰腹遮挡及露出的受缚双臂。
rows.transition: 连续木响接最后一根落下，铺柴告终才让教徒空手退开；不提前点燃。
rows.action: 最后一根乌烬木被放上去。低机位看，粗黑木堆一直压到Claude腰腹，把白裙下半部和固定脚托吞没；她的脸、胸口和受缚双臂还露在上方。教徒空手退下，所有柴尚未点燃。
rows.entry: 两次阻拦都没能让铺柴停下。
rows.exit: 柴堆完成，Claude腰腹以下被遮住，教徒退开。
rows.effects: 最后一根木头落定、退下脚步，教徒低沉吟唱渐起，不添加可辨歌词。

rows.title: 教主接过火把
rows.framing: 上半身中近景
rows.camera: 教主胸上中近景从交接火把的手短摇到抬起的目光，火杯始终留在画内，展示唯一道具归属。
rows.transition: 从铺柴完成切长阶下端仪式交接；低沉吟唱同空间连续，接牢后才抬头说话。
rows.action: Claude的父亲穿着教主礼服站在长阶下端。一名教徒递来唯一一支短柄仪式火把，杯口燃着黑芯、暗紫细边的火焰；教主用右手接牢，抬头看向高处画外的Claude，说出原句。固定火盆与蜡烛仍是普通暖色火。后续始终沿用这支短柄火把，不变成长杖。
rows.entry: 教徒铺柴完毕，教主准备执行火祭。
rows.exit: 教主持唯一一支火把；小鱼看见后再次站起。
rows.cast_note: 交火把中近景，Claude在高处画外。
rows.effects: 火苗近响与教徒吟唱底声，避让教主台词，不新增歌词。

rows.title: 最后一次，张开双臂
rows.framing: 下段阶下正面全景，张臂的孩子与高处柴堆同框
rows.camera: 阶下正面全景略随小鱼撑起而升高，稳在张臂全身与高处柴堆共框，避免把教主补入反打。
rows.transition: 从教主目光切被踢倒后又撑起的宝宝，画外命令对应她挡路，尚不加入推搡声。
rows.action: 小鱼看见教主接过火把，双手撑地，踉跄站起来，重新挪到长阶下端中央，张开双臂挡住通往Claude的路。帽子歪了，腿在发抖，她用身体挡路，没有施放魔法。
rows.entry: 她被踢倒；教主已经接火准备登阶。
rows.exit: 她站稳张臂，坚持不让。
rows.cast_note: 教主“让开”来自画外；高处Claude被柴堆遮住下半身。
rows.effects: 衣料摩擦、颤抖呼吸，教主短命令清楚。

@图片1：Claude四方向设定：身份、服装与饰物位置；同一人物的多个角度。

参考冲突优先级及取用范围：四视图负责人物设计，构图图负责空间。已指出的参考冲突按动态要求纠正，不把代表终态误当起帧。

8–11秒，参考@图片5。承接：从教主目光切被踢倒后又撑起的宝宝，画外命令对应她挡路，尚不加入推搡声。 画内：DeepSeek、Claude；倒影：无。教主“让开”来自画外；高处Claude被柴堆遮住下半身。 下段阶下正面全景，张臂的孩子与高处柴堆同框。运镜：阶下正面全景略随小鱼撑起而升高，稳在张臂全身与高处柴堆共框，避免把教主补入反打。 动作：小鱼看见教主接过火把，双手撑地，踉跄站起来，重新挪到长阶下端中央，张开双臂挡住通往Claude的路。帽子歪了，腿在发抖，她用身体挡路，没有施放魔法。 声音（细分秒数相对本镜起点）：衣料摩擦、颤抖呼吸，教主短命令清楚。

subject_definitions:

<Subject 2>: fully_preserved - identity and outfit design.

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
Claude keeps her own left-temple flower and ivory veil. During the church sequence she is barefoot; fire damage persists until departure. Clean clothes return only in the later market scene.
[Shot 1] Continue the log sounds into the final placement; only once the pile is complete do the cultists withdraw empty-handed. Use <Picture 3> for composition. The final black log is placed on the pile. From the low angle, thick timber covers Claude to her waist and abdomen, concealing the lower skirt and fixed footrest while her face, chest and restrained arms remain above it. The cultists withdraw with empty hands. None of the wood has ignited. In a low medium view of the altar, tilt slightly with the last log, then hold the pile's height against Claude's exposed bound upper body. The last log settles, footsteps withdraw, and a low wordless cultist chant begins.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, Cut from the finished pile to the ritual handover at the stair foot; carry the low chant through, with his gaze rising after the grip is secure. Use <Picture 4> for composition. Claude's father, the high priest, stands at the lower end of the stairs in formal robes. A cultist hands him the sole short-handled ritual torch. He takes it firmly in his right hand and looks up toward Claude offscreen above while speaking. Its flame has a black core and thin dark-violet rim; fixed braziers and candles retain ordinary warm flames. In an upper-body medium close-up, make a short pan from the torch handover to the priest's rising gaze, retaining the flame cup in frame. Close flame sound over a low wordless chant; keep the priest's calm line clear. From 4.5 to 7.1951 seconds, the High Priest (S1) speaks with matching lip movement: <d>[Chinese] 我的女儿，神明在等你。</d>.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, Cut from the priest's gaze to the child rising after the previous kick; the offscreen command addresses her obstruction without a shove yet. Use <Picture 5> for composition. DeepSeek sees the torch taken, pushes against the floor with both hands and staggers upright. With her hat crooked and legs trembling, she moves to the center of the lower stairs and spreads both arms to block the way to Claude above. The priest orders her aside from offscreen. She stays upright and uses no magic. Rise slightly with DeepSeek struggling upright in a frontal full shot, then hold her outstretched arms against the distant altar pile. Clothing shifts and shaky breathing accompany the clear offscreen command; the chant remains subdued. From 8 to 11 seconds, the High Priest (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 让开。</d>.
From 11 to 15 seconds, sustain the final state with natural micro-movement, without repeating actions or adding speech.

overall_soundscape:
Keep ambience and ongoing physical sounds continuous across cuts, following the shot-specific cues above. Dialogue appears only in its specified interval; do not add intelligible crowd speech. No generated music.

rows.title: 静止对视，高低之间
rows.framing: 平视小鱼高度的侧面双人中景，固定50mm，建立相互视线
rows.camera: 按原设计在小鱼眼高固定50mm侧面双人中景，留两人间距；这是有目的的对视停顿，不加推近或前冲。
rows.transition: Claude喊声收尾后切到下方对视，接原来张臂站姿；保持宝宝和教主左右关系。
rows.action: 小鱼仍在长阶下端张开双臂挡路，抬头直视教主。教主垂眼看她，嘴角带一点轻蔑，肩膀放松，右手持此前接过的唯一一支短柄黑焰仪式火把，左臂垂下。两人之间保留距离，只作一次持续对视，不前冲、不推、不摔；画面中不出现长杆火杖。
rows.entry: Claude喊完别碰她，小鱼仍张臂挡住教主。
rows.exit: 两人对视僵持，尚未发生推搡；下一镜开头教主才出手。
rows.effects: 脚步短停、轻微衣料、火把黑焰低鸣；静止对视不加撞击声。
rows.note: 此分镜火把形制与前面交接火把的镜头有历史差异；须统一为同一短柄仪式火把，修正前不冻结输入。

rows.transition: 袍尾滑脱接背后登阶，同一方向向上；只见代表性的几步，长阶余程在切点省略。

rows.exit: 教主正对Claude登到柴堆前，右手火把准备下压点火。

rows.title: 点燃高柴
rows.framing: 局部特写／火把与木柴接触处

rows.transition: 从登阶明确省略到已抵柴堆前；火把形制、右手与黑紫火色连续，接触时才起柴火。

rows.entry: 高柴围住Claude腰腹，尚未点燃。
rows.exit: 高柴整体起火，教主退回下段缓台。
rows.cast_note: 仅持火把的右手与柴木接触局部，退阶用剪辑省略。
rows.effects: 火头触木、树脂爆响、黑焰低吼，退阶脚步。

rows.title: 黑焰吞没祭坛
rows.framing: 中殿后部低机位／大远景／静帧候选
rows.camera: 中殿后部低位大全景缓缓后移，拉开教徒环列和火海尺度，始终不越过火幕寻找Claude。
rows.transition: 接同一持续火势，近景可见的人物变成火幕完全遮蔽；吟唱保持连续。
rows.action: 远景用连续黑焰完全遮住Claude；教徒环列吟唱，普通火盆保持橙色。

rows.exit: 火海与吟唱持续，切门外骑士列队。
rows.cast_note: Claude完全被黑焰遮蔽，不出现可辨认身体或脸。
rows.effects: 教徒低沉齐声吟唱、殿内混响与柴火爆裂；不添加可辨歌词。跨切外景图片5后由风声压低，回室内图片7恢复，图片8破门时骤停。

rows.title: 甲靴越前，两翼列阵
rows.framing: 门前低机位中远景／先拍骑士行动，不露GPT
rows.camera: 门外低位中远景轻向后移给骑士越前，再随两列分流作小幅横向构图调整，中央通道保持空。
rows.transition: 切门外同一时刻，室内吟唱变闷被夜风压低；甲靴声从后方接近，不提前揭GPT。
rows.action: 两列骑士从后方越前，分往两翼列队，侧口岗哨转身警戒，中央留空。
rows.entry: 夜风起，教堂门闭；援军正抵达。
rows.exit: 中央通道形成，GPT即将从画外迈入。
rows.cast_note: 不提前露GPT。
rows.effects: 甲靴齐步由后及前、甲片轻碰；最后两声枪尾触地接下一镜脚步。承上镜室内吟唱在外景压低，保留旗帜风声。

rows.title: 裙摆先至，迈步向门
rows.framing: 腰部以下局部揭示／侧后低机位腿部跟拍
rows.camera: 侧后低机位腿部平行跟拍两步，构图上缘严格停在腰下，保留两翼甲靴与枪杆作尺度。
rows.transition: 由枪尾触地节奏接银白鞋跟，不再重演骑士列队；沿留出的中路前进。
rows.action: 只见GPT双腿、银白鞋、裙摆与尾部向前走过列队，头脸始终画外。
rows.entry: 两翼骑士已列阵，中路留空。
rows.exit: GPT来到门前；切门内静默，再踹门揭示全身。
rows.cast_note: GPT只露腰下腿、裙摆、单尾；骑士可见甲靴与枪杆。
rows.effects: 两步清晰鞋跟声、衣料掠动，不提前放踹门重音。

rows.title: 破门前的静默
rows.framing: 正门环境远景
rows.camera: 门内中央通道远景刻意稳住，以门缝冷光和门板的一次震动建立预兆，不穿门展示来者。
rows.transition: 从门外脚步切门内对应位置，吟唱恢复清楚；震动是破门动作的预备，不另演一次完整撞门。
rows.action: 火光掠过空旷的中央通道，尽头正门已经关紧。冷光从门缝漏入，门板忽然一震。
rows.entry: 门外援军已到，门内柴火仍燃，吟唱仍在。
rows.exit: 门板震动，接GPT踹门。
rows.cast_note: 门内环境空镜，教徒吟唱和门外动静画外。
rows.effects: 回到室内恢复清楚的无词集体吟唱与殿内混响，门板震动，接图片8破门时吟唱骤停。

rows.title: 砰
rows.framing: 朝正门的中远景／祭坛在镜头后方
rows.camera: 朝正门中远景在踹开瞬间轻后撤承接气流，随即收稳，门扇运动与GPT跨入完整可辨。
rows.transition: 接门板同一次震动完成一次踹开，破门重音此刻落下，吟唱立即断掉。
rows.action: 一脚踹开门扇；冷光进来，木屑尘埃落下。
rows.entry: 教徒回堂时闩住的正门紧闭；祭坛已着火，吟唱继续。
rows.exit: 门已打开，踹门者跨入。
rows.cast_note: 踹门及跨入只揭示GPT，完整群像下镜。
rows.effects: 一次干脆破门声，教徒吟唱立刻切断。

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
[Shot 1] Continue the same fire, now completely obscuring the figure seen in close-up; the chant continues without restarting. Use <Picture 4> for composition. From the rear nave, continuous black fire entirely conceals Claude and any recognizable part of her body. Cultists chant around the altar; the priest is back on the lower landing, and DeepSeek remains below. Ordinary braziers stay orange. The ritual continues without a new action against the child. Ease backward in a low extreme wide shot from the rear nave, revealing the circle of cultists and scale of fire without penetrating it to find Claude. Low collective wordless chanting, church reverberation and crackling timber; no added intelligible lyrics.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, Cut outside at the same time; the indoor chant muffles beneath night wind as armored steps approach from behind, without revealing GPT. Use <Picture 5> for composition. Two ranks of silver-armored paladins advance from behind and split toward the two sides of the closed church entrance. Side sentries turn outward to watch the approaches. The central corridor remains empty, ready for GPT, who is still offscreen with the eight companions. Ease back in a low exterior medium-wide view as paladins overtake the camera, then reframe slightly for the two separating ranks, keeping the center clear. Synchronized armored steps move from rear to front, plates touch lightly, and two spear-butt taps lead into the next footsteps; wind muffles the distant chant.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, Match the spear taps to the silver heels, proceeding along the already cleared center without repeating the formation. Use <Picture 6> for composition. Only GPT's legs, silver-white shoes, moving skirt hem and single tail are revealed as she walks between the formed paladins toward the closed door. Her head and face remain outside the frame. The companions remain offscreen, and the paladins retain their positions at the sides. Track parallel from a low rear-side position for two steps, strictly cropping above the waist and retaining flanking armored boots and spear shafts. Two distinct heel steps and moving fabric; no early door-breaking impact.
[Shot 4] At 00:10.000, Cut from the exterior approach to the corresponding interior door view; the chant clears, and the tremor anticipates the single breaking action. Use <Picture 7> for composition. Looking from inside along the empty central aisle, the barred main door is still shut. Firelight crosses the floor while cold light leaks through its gaps. The panels shudder just before the breaking action. Nobody enters this environment-only frame yet. Hold a deliberate wide interior view down the empty central aisle, letting the cold door-gap light and one tremor create anticipation. Clearer wordless chanting and interior reverberation return, followed by a brief door-panel rattle leading directly to the break.
[Shot 5] At 00:12.000, Complete the same door disturbance with one kick; the breaking accent lands now and the chanting stops immediately. Use <Picture 8> for composition. GPT kicks the closed door open once. Cold exterior light enters, splinters and dust fall, and she steps through the opened doorway. Only GPT is revealed as the rescuer in this shot; the companions remain outside the framing until the following group reveal. In a medium-wide view toward the main door, make a small retreat at the kick's burst, then settle so the opening panels and GPT's step remain readable. One decisive door-breaking crash cuts off the chanting immediately; falling fragments and the entry step follow.
From 14 to 15 seconds, sustain the final state with natural micro-movement, without repeating actions or adding speech.

overall_soundscape:
Keep ambience and ongoing physical sounds continuous across cuts, following the shot-specific cues above. Dialogue appears only in its specified interval; do not add intelligible crowd speech. No generated music.

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
[Shot 1] Cut from the completed invocation to empty air outside the rear window; keep all four seconds uncut. Use <Picture 2> for composition. At 0-0.8 seconds, silver-white moonlight enters from behind and left of the camera, with no human silhouette. At 0.8-1.6 it slows and gathers in front of the glass. At 1.6-3.5, hair and shoulders become solid first; the hem, legs and small blades form from connected light filaments, with background visible through unfinished gaps. At 3.5-4, one solid Kimi floats facing the glass, back to camera, both hands low: her left bright blade is screen left and her right dark blade screen right. She does not turn, raise a blade or land. The physical moon stays behind the camera, outside frame. No black smoke, portal or overall opacity fade. Use a distant direct rear full-body view, with Kimi about half of frame height before the towering intact window. Dolly forward slightly on her rear axis and ease to a stop as she becomes solid; never orbit or reveal her face. The previous invocation decays into continuous night wind and a faint airy gathering sound; no impact or new speech. Continuous state progression in batch seconds: at 0, <Picture 3> (start, flowing moonlight without a human silhouette); at 1.6, <Picture 2> (intermediate, light becomes the rear silhouette while hem and legs remain light); at 3.5, <Picture 4> (end, fully solid rear view with both blades held low). Animate between these states without cuts, still-image holds or a whole-body opacity fade.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, After materialization completes, cut the CAMERA from behind to the established exterior side close-up; Kimi never turns away from the same glass. Preserve wind and blade hands; throw after the complete request. Use <Picture 5> for composition. Kimi remains outside the window, visibly looking inside. She raises the small bright blade in her left hand beside her shoulder while holding the dark blade low in her right. She speaks the entire request, leaves its prescribed brief pause, then throws the bright blade toward screen right and forward. Her body stays outside and the hands never exchange weapons. No shield or additional moon ring appears. Once in the exterior side medium close-up, reframe slightly with the raised left-hand blade, then hold for the full request and throw; keep intact glass at the right edge. Continuous night wind beneath the request; the throw follows the spoken line, while glass impact is reserved for the following shot. rows.title: 明刃破窗，玻璃迎面炸开
rows.framing: 刀刃撞穿玻璃的力量特写，近处碎片与明刃同框
rows.camera: 窗内近处力量特写先守住刀尖触点，撞裂后短促跟刀向内下方摇移，让近碎片形成纵深，不跟成穿堂长镜。
rows.transition: 从窗外投出切内侧撞入，斜向下轨迹连贯；玻璃接触前完整，接触后才爆裂。
rows.action: 切中央彩窗的近距离特写。Kimi从窗外甩出的明刃斜向下撞入玻璃，刀锋先顶裂受力点，窗棂局部折断，厚蓝玻璃沿放射裂纹炸开。近处碎片冲过镜头形成速度与纵深，明刃穿过宽阔纵向破口飞向柴堆外缘；外石框和下部窗棂保留，左右窗完整。Kimi本人不穿窗，玻璃随后落在刑架后方与后墙边，避开Claude。
rows.entry: Kimi说完请求后甩出左手明刃，彩窗仍完整到刀锋接触。
rows.exit: 明刃穿入殿内，中央玻璃留下宽阔破口。
rows.cast_note: 仅明刃与玻璃；Kimi不穿窗、没有实体入画。
rows.effects: 咏唱暂停；硬脆撞击→密集玻璃爆裂→刀锋掠过→碎片坠地尾响，尾声下降，不盖下一镜术名。

rows.title: 明刃钉柴，瞬移坐标亮起
rows.framing: 外缘柴木与单枚明刃近景，人物暂不入画
rows.camera: 柴木与明刃近景先短随刀尖下落，钉稳即停止，银光亮收期间不围绕刀旋转。
rows.transition: 同一刀锋飞行接向下钉木，碎玻璃尾响压低，让画外术名落在已钉稳之后。
rows.action: 明刃下尖钉入柴堆前侧外缘的一根乌烬木，木纤维裂开。接触点的银光短促亮起，刀已稳稳留在木上，Kimi才从画外报出术名“月影渡”。镜末银光收拢，接她沿坐标瞬移现身；刀不插地、不展开护罩，高柴仍燃烧。画面此刻还没有Kimi实体。
rows.entry: 明刃已穿过中央彩窗，飞向柴堆外缘。
rows.exit: 明刃成为固定坐标，术名落定，接Kimi循刃瞬移。
rows.cast_note: 仅明刃钉柴；Kimi术名画外。
rows.effects: 0—0.5秒刀尖入木与纤维裂响，玻璃尾声降下；避让0.6—1.8秒术名，最后一字接短促瞬移低鸣，爆气在下一镜。

rows.title: 循刃瞬临，爆气震开柴堆
rows.framing: 低机位中全景，左前Kimi现身，重柴向两侧推出，后方Claude平静留中
rows.camera: 低位中全景在现身一闪后轻后移，容纳两侧重柴推出的幅度，Claude始终居后方中央净区；不环绕改变明暗刃左右手。
rows.transition: 明刃坐标银光接一次现身，术名尾音引出爆气；刀从木上回左手，不出现第二个Kimi。
rows.action: 银光一闪，Kimi在柴堆前侧外缘循明刃瞬移现身，左手握回明刃。她压低重心，气浪沿石面向两侧外下方爆开，将重柴成片推开；木头翻滚、刮地、撞击，Claude与刑架所在的中央保持平静。Kimi双脚落在腾出的石地上，右手暗刃朝外低垂，刀口远离Claude。此时尚未闭罩，残柴在两侧继续燃烧；Claude仍直立受缚，腕踝扣与固定脚托露出。身影只有少量消散的银色余光，不出现第二个身体。
rows.entry: 月影渡术名落定，明刃已钉稳柴木成为坐标。
rows.exit: 重柴向两侧散开，明刃回左手，Claude中心平静，尚未闭罩。
rows.effects: 承术名尾音的瞬移低鸣→低频爆气→重木刮石翻落；不重复念咒，不延长成漂浮碎片声。

rows.title: 震柴惊动教徒，转身施法
rows.framing: 侧前低机位，黑袍教徒前景夹住后方Kimi与Claude
rows.camera: 侧前低位从近处转身的教徒手臂短摇到同框后方Kimi，保留敌我间净空通道和攻击指向。
rows.transition: 重柴翻落尾音接教徒转身聚能，Kimi只转向新威胁，不重复震柴。
rows.action: 柴堆被震开，祭坛两侧的黑金袍教徒转身围向中央。近景有人抬起空手，有人举杖，琥珀色火星在掌心和杖端收拢，攻击方向朝向后方Kimi与Claude。Kimi尚未闭罩，压低重心转向攻击者，右暗刃抬起，左明刃保持在身体外侧；Claude直立受缚，腕踝锁扣和固定脚托不变。人物分处散柴外侧通道与中央净空区，互不穿过火堆。
rows.entry: Kimi循刃震开柴堆，两侧教徒仍在祭坛边。
rows.exit: 教徒攻击即将发出，Kimi抬起右暗刃，接闭罩拦截。
rows.effects: 重柴滚落尾音、黑袍急转脚步、教徒掌心与杖端聚能；不新增对白。

rows.title: 暗月闭合，截住教徒法术
rows.framing: 罩外低机位中远景，教徒施法源与命中点同框
rows.camera: 罩外低位中远景缓退让闭合罩体填入构图，同时保住两侧施法手和命中点；闭合后镜头绝不穿透罩面。
rows.transition: 聚能动作接同一轮光束发出，Kimi划右暗刃在命中前闭罩；冲击声由清晰转闷留给下一批。
rows.action: 两侧教徒已经聚起的琥珀色光束朝中央发出。开镜时Kimi与Claude仍可见；Kimi退到Claude身前，右手暗刃向上划弧，在光束命中前让深靛暗月罩完整闭合，包住两人、刑架与脚托。闭合后罩面完全不透明，人物和刑架全部不可见。光束撞上外壳碎成短促火星，两侧施法手与法杖始终交代攻击来源。罩面保持完整，所有燃木留在罩外；火星自然散去，不停格。GPT此时尚未释放水流。
rows.entry: 震柴惊动两侧教徒，他们抬手聚起法术，Kimi转身护住Claude。
rows.exit: 教徒第一轮攻击被暗罩截住，接罩内试镣；外侧仍有间歇攻击。
rows.cast_note: 动作起始Kimi与Claude可见；罩闭合后两人及刑架完全不可见。
rows.effects: 教徒聚能尖鸣→两道破空法术→暗壳短促碎裂声；切入罩内后压成遥远闷响。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1>: Kimi, identity and outfit from four-view sheet <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2>: Claude, identity and outfit from four-view sheet <Picture 2>.
<Picture 3>: [Shot 1] composition and state reference; not its first frame.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second sequence. The bright blade breaks the window and anchors in a log. Kimi teleports to it, scatters the timber, then closes an opaque shield against the cultists' attack.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - identity and outfit design.
<Subject 2>: fully_preserved - identity and outfit design.
<Picture 3>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.
<Picture 4>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.
<Picture 5>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.
<Picture 6>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.
<Picture 7>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
Claude keeps her own left-temple flower and ivory veil. During the church sequence she is barefoot; fire damage persists until departure. Clean clothes return only in the later market scene.
[Shot 1] Match the previous throw; glass breaks only on contact. Use <Picture 3> for composition. The bright blade cracks the central blue window, breaks local mullions and passes through a broad vertical opening toward the woodpile's outer edge. Stone frame, lower mullions and side windows remain. Fragments fall behind the cross, away from Claude. Kimi stays outside. Hold the impact close-up, then follow briefly downward inside. Hard impact, glass burst, passing blade, falling fragments; decay lowers.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, Match the flight into wood; Kimi remains offscreen. Use <Picture 4> for composition. The bright blade embeds point-down in a black log at the burning pile's front outer edge, not the floor. Fibers split and silver light flashes. The anchor is firmly established before the offscreen spell name; light gathers afterward. No body or shield appears. Follow the descending tip closely; stop when anchored. Wood strike and fiber split precede the spell name; then a brief teleport hum. From 3.6 to 4.8 seconds, Kimi (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 月影渡！</d>.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, Match the anchor flash to one arrival. Use <Picture 5> for composition. Kimi teleports directly to the anchored blade, reclaiming it left-handed. Lowering her stance, she blasts heavy logs outward and down to both sides. She lands on cleared stone, right-hand dark blade low and outward. Claude remains calm at center, upright on the exposed fixed footrest, all five restraints closed. Displaced wood still burns; no shield yet. Retreat slightly in a low medium-full view. Teleport hum, pressure burst, heavy timber scraping.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, Continue falling timber; do not repeat the blast. Use <Picture 6> for composition. Cultists in the altar's outer lanes turn inward, gathering amber energy in raised palms and staff tips toward Kimi and Claude. Kimi turns low toward them, lifting her right-hand dark blade; the bright blade stays outside her left side. Claude remains bound upright on the fixed footrest. All stay clear of burning logs; no shield yet. Pan briefly from foreground cultist arms toward Kimi behind. Rolling logs, hurried robe movements, rising energy.
[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, Continue charged attacks into release; shield closes before impact. Use <Picture 7> for composition. Initially visible, Kimi steps before Claude and sweeps her right-hand dark blade upward. A deep-indigo dome encloses both women, cross and footrest, becoming fully opaque: all are hidden. Two amber beams strike outside and scatter sparks. Cultist hands and staffs remain visible beside the intact shell; burning wood stays outside. No GPT water yet. Retreat slightly, retaining attackers and impact points. Charge, rushing beams, shattering sparks; next interior cut muffles impacts.
From 14 to 15 seconds, sustain the final state with natural micro-movement, without repeating actions or adding speech.

overall_soundscape:
Keep ambience and ongoing physical sounds continuous across cuts, following the shot-specific cues above. Dialogue appears only in its specified interval; do not add intelligible crowd speech. No generated music.

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
Claude keeps her own left-temple flower and ivory veil. During the church sequence she is barefoot; fire damage persists until departure. Clean clothes return only in the later market scene.
[Shot 1] Hard-cut from the opaque exterior to an interior viewpoint with only the inner dark membrane behind them; do not fly through or make the shell transparent. Use <Picture 7> for composition. Inside the dome, Kimi briefly tests the seam of one of Claude's wrist cuffs from below with the dark blade in her right hand. Tiny violet markings react, hurting Claude. Kimi immediately withdraws the blade toward the outside of her own hip, its edge facing outward and down, and looks at the lock with concern. The restraints remain shut. Stowing both blades at her rear waist is omitted across the subsequent cut before the next interior view, leaving her hands free afterward. The dome persists, and no church, candle or window shows through its interior background. In an interior medium close-up, shift focus gently from the cuff seam to Claude's pain and Kimi's reaction; make a small downward reframe with the withdrawing blade. A light metal touch, a short sharp cuff resonance and immediate withdrawal; outside attacks remain distant muffled knocks. Rear-waist catches sound only if the stowing action is actually shown.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, Hard-cut from the interior cuff reaction to the entrance, restoring clear armor and footfalls; this remains the present and the vanguard does not enter again. Use <Picture 8> for composition. With GPT and the eight companions already inside, additional paladins cross the open threshold and move down both side colonnades. Entry sentries remain at their posts. The central aisle is left clear; the vanguard stays outside this shot's framing. Track sideways a short distance from a low interior angle as paladins cross and split, then settle on the two aisle depths with the center open. Paladin footsteps and armor plates in the church's current interior ambience.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, Make an explicit cut to an earlier flashback at the cloud palace during DeepSeek's solo rescue; remove the church battle sound rather than treating this as adjacent space. Use <Picture 9> for composition. Earlier, during DeepSeek's attempt to rescue Claude alone, GPT stands before Qwen in the cloud palace and delivers her invitation. Qwen holds her fan open and listens. The fan remains open at the end; her acceptance and closing gesture belong to the next shot. No child is being held in this earlier scene. Use a short lateral move in a medium-full cloud-palace two-shot to establish the facing pair and open fan, then settle for GPT's invitation. Cloud-palace ambience beneath the invitation; the response belongs to the next shot. From 6.1 to 8.76531 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks with matching lip movement: <d>[Chinese] 千问，陪我救个人。</d>.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, Cut after the invitation to the same open fan, let the closing gesture settle, and keep Qwen's short reply with her mouth outside the frame. Use <Picture 10> for composition. In the same earlier cloud-palace encounter, Qwen closes the fan once and grips its ribs with her fingertips as she accepts. Only her hand and the fan are visible; GPT remains offscreen. The fan stays closed after the action. In a hand-and-fan close-up, make a slight pan with the closing fan, stopping at the closed grip. One crisp fan closure leads into the short acceptance without covering it. From 9.2 to 10.3748 seconds, Qwen (S2) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 走吧。</d>.
[Shot 5] At 00:11.000, Let the fan sound finish, then cut to another location within the earlier recruitment montage; the book is already open, without a shown journey. Use <Picture 11> for composition. Earlier, at Gemini's cottage, Gemini sits before an already open book while GPT stands beside the table. In one two-shot GPT calls her name; Gemini lifts her eyes from the pages and answers. She has agreed by the end, and the book stays on the table without another placing or opening action. In the cottage two-shot, tilt slightly from Gemini and the already open book to include GPT beside the table, then retain both for the call and reply. Quiet indoor flame ambience and slight paper movement; the name, brief pause and reply remain clear within the shot. From 11.1 to 12.4722 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks with matching lip movement: <d>[Chinese] Gemini。</d>. From 13 to 14.1864 seconds, Gemini (S3) speaks with matching lip movement: <d>[Chinese] 我去。</d>.

rows.title: 抱紧我

rows.title: 掌前爆发，暗金术矛
rows.framing: 低机位近中景，右臂强透视指向左上，脸和发射口同框
rows.camera: 贴右臂低机位短促上摇承手掌推出，终点停在术光离掌方向，不追完整轨迹。
rows.transition: 接空中起咏切地面敌人仰视，推出方向交给下一镜扇叶拦截；咏唱不断。
rows.action: 教主仍在下段中央缓台，视线锁定高处GPT。低机位贴近他的右臂和侧脸，右肩带动手臂向左上方猛然推出，左臂后收稳住重心，黑金袍摆被发力带起。一枚暗金术矛从掌前迸出，掌根近处有厚实的短促压光，矛体越远越收细，朝高处GPT疾射。攻击只有这一枚离手的实体化术光，不是不断供能的巨炮，也不增加多弹；后镜千问用单枚扇叶偏转它的侧面轨迹。他未变身、未开罩，屋顶此时完整。
rows.entry: GPT已经升空起咏，教主仍在下段缓台。
rows.exit: 暗金术光斜向空中，切千问截击。
rows.cast_note: GPT咏唱为画外。
rows.effects: 短促掌前压光爆发接术矛上行破风，避让连续画外咏唱；离手后无连续炮声。

rows.title: 开扇咔响，单叶解锁
rows.framing: 右手、扇轴与扇骨极近特写／浅景深
rows.camera: 右手扇轴微距机位不绕手，轻随腕上挑，焦点由拇指扣转到末端弹片，孩子不被揭出。
rows.transition: 术矛破风跨切开扇细响；扇叶弹离的方向与下一镜上行一致，不能反向飞回。
rows.action: 拇指拨扣，甩腕开扇，扇骨依次展开；外缘单叶卡扣解锁，末端弹离，切伴飞。孩子始终由画外左臂托稳。 出叶前右腕上挑、发射方向斜向上；左臂托抱不变。
rows.entry: 教主术光已射出；千问左臂抱稳小鱼，右手持尚未完全展开的扇子。
rows.exit: 单叶自右手向上弹出，母扇仍在手中，接同方向上行极特写。
rows.cast_note: Qwen仅右手开扇；左臂抱宝宝画外，GPT咏唱画外。
rows.effects: 0.15秒扇轴短咔；0.3—1.1秒扇骨依次展开的轻细金属声；1.4秒单叶卡扣轻响；1.7秒弹脱破空。声音轻脆，不用枪械上膛、重齿轮或引擎声，避让跨镜咏唱。

rows.title: 扇叶上行，刃尖侧前极特写
rows.framing: 刃尖侧前方略低机位朝后拍／强透视缩短／左下至右上爬升
rows.camera: 摄影机在刃尖侧前下方倒退伴飞，保留右上刃尖和左下叶尾的透视缩短，不绕叶旋转。
rows.transition: 沿上一镜出叶矢量接运动匹配；只在接近交汇点时切侧机位，碰撞留到下一镜。
rows.action: 刃尖右上近镜、叶尾左下后退，持续斜向上伴飞，微旋反光；画面仅一枚实体扇叶。
rows.entry: 单枚扇叶由地面千问右手向上发射，方形叶尾低于刃尖。
rows.exit: 沿上行轨迹接近高处拦截点；接触前不向下转向。
rows.cast_note: 只见一枚实体扇叶，无人脸无敌方术光；GPT咏唱画外。
rows.effects: 环境声短暂压低，细薄破空声；碰撞声留下一镜，跨镜咏唱不变调。

rows.title: 侧面仰拍，半空截击
rows.framing: 与飞行镜相差约70度的侧面低机位仰拍／撞击近景／叶身侧面与柱廊高度参照
rows.camera: 约70度侧移后的低位近景定住交汇点，碰撞时允许极轻短震，随后随失速叶片下倾一点。
rows.transition: 在两条上升轨迹相交时切入；撞响接罩内闷声，不能让高速碰撞打断同一句咏唱。
rows.action: 扇叶从左下向右上击中右下朝左上的暗金术光；小亮点后残光偏散，碰撞失速后叶片才开始落向空侧廊。
rows.entry: 两条由低处射向高处的轨迹将交汇；扇叶仍在上行。
rows.exit: 高处截击完成，千问始终站地护人，GPT空中咏唱继续。
rows.cast_note: 只见扇叶与术光碰撞；GPT咏唱画外。
rows.effects: 恢复常速时一声短促清脆撞击，残光散去，随后接罩内微光；跨镜咏唱连续。

rows.title: 抱住她，先让她缓一口气
rows.framing: 罩内贴近双人中景，额侧相贴、托肩背，锁着的双腕保留在画面中
rows.camera: 罩内双人中景小幅侧移至肩背承托关系，停在额侧贴近处；腕扣仍完整入画，机位不穿暗膜。
rows.transition: 撞击尾音压成罩外闷响后切入安静近景，Kimi已收刃，不重拍收刀；咏唱续到本镜完句。
rows.action:
罩内，Kimi已经收好双刃，空手靠到Claude身前偏左，托住肩背，另一只手轻扶上臂，额侧贴近她的头。Claude仍直立受缚，双腕没有离开横木，只把头轻轻靠向Kimi的肩，缓下一口气。Kimi听向罩外教徒法术的闷响与远处潮声，同时继续托稳她；没有解锁，也没有将她抱离脚托。

GPT第二句咏唱从前面的阻击连续接来，至本镜念完，不重复起句。
rows.entry: 罩体维持，Kimi双刃已收好，Claude仍受缚。
rows.exit: 托抱使Claude缓下一口气，接拭汗拨发。
rows.cast_note: GPT咏唱画外，不能让Kimi或Claude代说。
rows.effects: 衣料、呼吸，罩外敌法闷响与高空潮鸣，避让同一句画外咏唱。

rows.title: 拭汗拨发，确认她的状态
rows.framing: 罩内面部与肩侧近景，拭汗、拨发和目光交流
rows.camera: 从前镜肩部支点匹配切面肩近景，轻微焦点转移由拭汗指尖到Claude眼神；摄影机保持侧位。
rows.transition: 拭汗承同一次安抚，不让Kimi松开后重新抱；暗膜隔绝外景，声音只带入远潮。
rows.action: Kimi轻轻拨开Claude额前汗湿的发丝，指尖拭去鬓侧汗水；另一只手拨开落在领侧的发梢，查看肩侧衣料焦损与可见皮肤。Claude疲惫地望向她，把头微微靠向触碰。检查不掀衣、不拉扯束具，腕扣仍锁着，焦损衣料没有恢复。暗膜内侧遮住全部外景，柔和冷光托出两人的表情。
rows.entry: Claude靠近Kimi缓过气，腕扣未开。
rows.exit: 拭去汗水，确认焦损与束具状态。
rows.effects: 轻缓呼吸、发丝衣料细响，画外咏唱持续，不添加对白。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1>: Qwen, identity and outfit from four-view sheet <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2>: Kimi, identity and outfit from four-view sheet <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3>: Claude, identity and outfit from four-view sheet <Picture 3>.

<Picture 9>: [Shot 6] composition and state reference; not its first frame.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second sequence. One upward spear meets one fan leaf; the same chant bridges their collision into intimate support inside the shield.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - identity and outfit design.
<Subject 2>: fully_preserved - identity and outfit design.
<Subject 3>: fully_preserved - identity and outfit design.
<Picture 4>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.
<Picture 5>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.
<Picture 6>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.
<Picture 7>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.
<Picture 8>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.
<Picture 9>: weak_reference - shot layout; animate the specified action.

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
Claude keeps her own left-temple flower and ivory veil. During the church sequence she is barefoot; fire damage persists until departure. Clean clothes return only in the later market scene.
[Shot 1] Cut to the grounded leader looking upward. Use <Picture 4> for composition. On the lower landing, the leader thrusts his right arm upper-left, launching one dark-gold spear at airborne GPT. No shield, transformation, sustained beam or volley. The roof remains intact. Tilt briefly along the thrusting right arm, ending on its upward trajectory. A short compressed burst becomes an ascending whoosh. From 0 to 1 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 统御<scenetrans></d>. Voice continues across the cut.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, Match the spear threat to the defensive launch. Use <Picture 5> for composition. Qwen supports the child with her left arm. Her right thumb releases the catch; ribs open, one outer leaf unlocks and launches upward. The main fan remains held. Follow the right wrist slightly upward in macro. Effect timings are relative to this shot start: Fine clicks: pivot at 0.15, ribs 0.3–1.1, latch 1.4, release 1.7 seconds. No gun or engine sounds. From 1 to 3 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] <scenetrans>万千<scenetrans></d>. Voice continues across the cut.
[Shot 3] At 00:03.000, Match the rising launch vector; contact follows next. Use <Picture 6> for composition. One fan leaf climbs lower-left to upper-right, tip near camera and square tail receding below. Slight roll catches light. It never turns downward before interception. Track backward ahead and below the tip. Thin rushing air; no collision yet. From 3 to 5 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] <scenetrans>深流<scenetrans></d>. Voice continues across the cut.
[Shot 4] At 00:05.000, Cut roughly 70 degrees from the flight view. Use <Picture 7> for composition. The rising fan leaf strikes the side of the oppositely rising dark-gold spear. A small flash deflects and disperses the attack. Only afterward does the stalled leaf fall toward the empty aisle. Hold the crossing point from a low side angle. One crisp impact decays toward the shield interior. From 5 to 6 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] <scenetrans>的<scenetrans></d>. Voice continues across the cut.
[Shot 5] At 00:06.000, Muffle the impact before cutting inside. Use <Picture 8> for composition. Kimi's blades are already stowed. She supports Claude's shoulder and upper arm, temples close. Claude remains upright, wrists locked, feet supported, only leaning her head slightly and exhaling. The opaque shield hides everything outside; no unlocking or lifting. Slide slightly inside, retaining locked wrists. Clothing, breathing, muffled hostile spells and distant water. From 6 to 9 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] <scenetrans>水之灵啊，<scenetrans></d>. Voice continues across the cut.
[Shot 6] At 00:09.000, Continue the same reassurance without re-embracing. Use <Picture 9> for composition. Kimi moves sweat-damp hair, wipes Claude's temple and checks the scorched shoulder. Claude leans toward her touch. Do not lift clothing, tug restraints or repair burns. Wrists remain locked; the opaque interior shows no exterior. Focus from wiping fingers to Claude's eyes. Light breathing, hair and fabric movement. From 9 to 12.9 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] <scenetrans>请将散落尘世的万千水息，</d>. Voice continues across the cut.
From 13 to 15 seconds, sustain the final state with natural micro-movement, without repeating actions or adding speech.

overall_soundscape:
Keep ambience and ongoing physical sounds continuous across cuts, following the shot-specific cues above. Dialogue appears only in its specified interval; do not add intelligible crowd speech. No generated music.

rows.title: 水息上浮，合滴回弹
rows.framing: 水珠微距／浅景深／随大滴缓慢上移
rows.camera: 微距随大滴缓慢上移，小幅拉焦接近的小滴，合并后回到大滴轮廓；不变成雨滴下落。
rows.transition: 从罩内冷光切液面月光，以上升方向接天空水海，不把护罩当水源。
rows.action: 大水珠晃动、拉长回弹，小滴向上靠近并融入；云影逐渐掩月，上浮方向引向下一镜云腹。
rows.entry: 护盾已经形成，外部水雾凝滴，月光尚能照见液面。
rows.exit: 小滴融入大滴并继续上升，云影渐浓。
rows.cast_note: 纯水珠微距，GPT咏唱画外。
rows.effects: 水滴液桥合并轻响、高空长风，无落雨或电流音。

rows.title: 云腹聚水，倒悬之海
rows.framing: 外景低处仰拍，全景交代天空与完整教堂
rows.camera: 地面低角大全景先保留完整教堂轮廓，再慢慢上摇让云中海占据上方；机位不上云。
rows.transition: 水珠上升方向接云腹旋卷，水面中心收拢时切高空陡俯；长风跨镜不重启。
rows.action: 切到教堂外低处，从地面仰拍中殿上空。完整尖塔与屋顶轮廓压在下缘，层层深蓝云壁向中心旋卷，上浮水珠融入云腹；云褶之间托住连续的深蓝水面，银色月光沿涟漪流动，仿佛整片海悬于夜空。水只在高空汇聚，没有闪电或发光法环。云心正对中央中殿，后殿不在破坏区。镜末水面向中心收拢，为下一镜水龙下行蓄势。
rows.entry: 水珠上浮，屋顶完整。

subject_definitions:

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
[Shot 1] Cut from the cool shield interior to moonlight on the liquid; its upward movement leads into the suspended sky-sea, without implying that the shield is the water source. Use <Picture 1> for composition. With the protective shield already established, exterior mist condenses into droplets. The large drop quivers, elongates and springs back as smaller drops rise and merge into it. Clouds increasingly obscure the moon. End with the merged drop still ascending toward the gathering cloud mass. Track upward slowly with the large droplet, briefly focusing on smaller approaching drops and returning to its outline after they merge; never turn the motion into falling rain. Soft liquid-bridge merging sounds and high wind; no rainfall, electricity or thunder. From 0 to 5.4 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 汇作悬于群星之下的无岸之海。</d>.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.500, Continue the droplet ascent into converging clouds, cutting high overhead as the water gathers centrally; carry the wind across the cut. Use <Picture 2> for composition. From outside at ground level, keep the intact towers and nave roof along the lower edge. Layered deep-blue cloud walls curl inward above the central nave; rising droplets merge into a continuous dark-blue water surface suspended among the folds, with silver moonlight moving across ripples. Water gathers only high above, with no lightning or luminous magic circle. The apse remains outside the damage zone. End with the surface drawing inward to launch the descending water dragon. Start low with the intact cathedral silhouette, then tilt slowly upward as the suspended sea fills the upper frame; keep the camera on the ground. High wind and deep tidal resonance sit below the incantation. No lightning or thunder. From 5.5 to 8.1 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 以重云为岸，以长风为引，</d>. From 8.1 to 11.4 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 令沉睡的潮汐翻卷，奔涌而来。</d>.
[Shot 3] At 00:11.500, Cut from the converging cloud center to the back of the diving head. Break the roof at one site only and bridge the first crack into the next close shot. Use <Picture 3> for composition. A single deep-blue water dragon descends from the cloud sea toward the still-intact central nave. Its massive curved neck and rear head are close to the camera, while towers, long roof ridge and apse establish the height below. The head reaches the designated roof point first and the long foreshortened body follows. At the end, the muzzle strikes and stone tiles open the first breach. The apse roof and side windows remain intact; the dragon does not originate from a hand or the ground. From a steep high angle, descend beside the water dragon's axis as the head falls, retaining the distant cathedral as a scale reference; stop following at roof contact for the cut. Wind tightens into a falling-water roar; the first stone-and-tile crack arrives at the end. No thunder. From 11.5 to 14.9 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 此刻，洞开天穹，倒悬沧海；</d>.

overall_soundscape:
Keep ambience and ongoing physical sounds continuous across cuts, following the shot-specific cues above. Dialogue appears only in its specified interval; do not add intelligible crowd speech. No generated music.

整段事件：同一破顶从下方承接，罩内检查与敌方仰视交替，反应切镜为水龙回卷盘身提供省略。

参考素材按实际上传顺序对应 @图片N（在提交平台确认关联到对应素材）：
@图片1：Kimi四方向设定：身份、服装与饰物位置；同一人物的多个角度。
@图片2：Claude四方向设定：身份、服装与饰物位置；同一人物的多个角度。
@图片3：构图、空间与代表状态：贴近破口，水首掠镜；不是默认首帧。
@图片4：构图、空间与代表状态：蹲下查看踝链；不是默认首帧。
@图片5：构图、空间与代表状态：教主追视入殿水龙；不是默认首帧。
四视图只约束同一人物的外观，不复制卡片布局或多个人物；动作、人数、受伤和服装阶段按镜头时间线。构图图不代替身份四视图。Claude花饰固定自身左鬓；教堂受缚至离殿赤足，受火后的焦损持续到离殿；数日后街市恢复清洁服装。
参考冲突优先级及取用范围：四视图负责人物设计，构图图负责空间。已指出的参考冲突按动态要求纠正，不把代表终态误当起帧。
空间、人物与道具连续性：同一动作跨切镜不重演；屏幕方向和道具持有关系连续。龙首已触顶，不能重新飞回云海再次撞下；近景只展开同一个中央中殿破口。

0–1.5秒，参考@图片3。承接：以同一石瓦裂声和撞点匹配切入下方，先裂石再水腹掠过；接反应切镜省略回卷。 画内：仅环境/道具；倒影：无。仅同一召唤水龙与破顶碎石，不出现第二个人或龙。 18mm超广角贴近破口下沿仰拍，轻微倾斜，龙首强透视冲向近前景。运镜：18mm超广角藏破口下沿偏轴仰拍，让龙首越近景放大掠过；只在擦近时一次短震，不追甩。 动作：承接俯视镜末的同一撞点，机位藏在中殿穹顶破口下沿，偏离水龙轴线，以超广角向上迎拍。龙首从左上远处猛冲向右下近处，鼻吻和下颌迅速放大并掠出画边，长颈缩向同一破口，保留龙眉与一只眼的清晰体积。近前景一块断拱石擦过画边，后层小碎石与粉尘沿冲势飞落，形成明确的近大远小；运动模糊集中于碎石边缘与背景，水首关键轮廓仍清楚。先听石材断裂，后见厚重水腹掠过机位；摄影机只在擦过瞬间短促受震，不持续乱抖。水龙进入中殿后转向GPT外侧，碎块落往无人侧廊，避开吊灯和友方。始终只有中央中殿同一个破口，后殿不受损；接Kimi与教主反应切镜，跨切完成回卷盘身。 声音（细分秒数相对本镜起点）：近处干脆石裂接低频破顶重击，碎石擦过由近到远，水啸掠过；无对白或雷电声。
1.5–5.5秒，参考@图片4。承接：破顶轰鸣进入罩内变闷，接手靠近踝扣；GPT继续画外咏唱，不让两人代说。 画内：Kimi、Claude；倒影：无。Claude主要露小腿脚托；GPT咏唱画外。 罩内侧面中近景，Kimi蹲下查看踝链，保留脸、双手与固定脚托。运镜：罩内侧面中近景随Kimi屈膝缓慢下摇，停在脸、手、踝扣和脚托同框，不给跨罩外的揭示。 动作：Kimi在脚托旁蹲下，一只空手轻托Claude踝扣上方的小腿，另一只手查看外侧链环与锁扣连接，动作轻，不强拉、不解锁。Claude双腿垂直，双踝仍锁，赤足稳踩十字架立柱上的窄脚托。镜头带到Kimi专注的脸与双手，双刃收在后腰；衣裙自然垂落，原有白金纹样和黑色焦损保持。罩内石地净空，没有燃木和外界窗光。 声音（细分秒数相对本镜起点）：罩外破顶余响逐渐变闷，锁链轻响与呼吸；水龙在画外回卷，最高祭坛无水撞击声，GPT咏唱来自画外。
5.5–9.5秒，参考@图片5。承接：从罩内手部检查切到教主听声反应，水身回卷声跨切，不能再拍一次破顶。 画内：教主；倒影：无。纯水龙反光不算角色倒影，GPT咏唱画外。 沿用面部近景，屋顶保持画外。运镜：教主近景轻随抬眼上摇一点，保持屋顶画外，让银蓝反光滑过脸侧揭示水龙运动。 动作：教主仍在下段中央缓台，听到破顶巨响，抬眼追踪已经入殿的水龙；眉眼绷紧，另一只手抬起准备护身。画外龙身经过高处投下流动的银蓝反光，脸侧仍有尚未扑灭的火盆暖光。这个近景不显示屋顶；中殿已破，后殿完整，教主衣袍仍干，暗金护罩尚未展开。GPT在反应切镜期间持续结印，水龙沿她身后外侧回卷。 声音（细分秒数相对本镜起点）：破顶尾响衰减，厚重水身回卷低鸣、衣料声；GPT咏唱画外连续。

声音及跨镜承接：1.5–5.4秒，ChatGPT：『令灼烧无辜的烈焰，在奔流中止息；』。画外/嘴部不入画；不让在画人物代说。
5.5–9.4秒，ChatGPT：『将阻挡吾行的高墙，淹没于万顷狂澜！』。画外/嘴部不入画；不让在画人物代说。
说话语言为中文，原句只说规定次数。画内说话者自然口型，画外声不让在画人物代说；连续咏唱跨镜保持同一声线。环境音与动作音随动作发生；既有BGM与全片连续配音由后期统筹，不在每个15秒重新起乐。正式声线与口型待验。
剪辑余量：9.5–15秒延续末镜终态与自然微动，不新增动作或对白；后期剪除该余量。
不生成BGM、字幕、时码、镜号、参考编号或水印。

subject_definitions:

<Subject 2>: fully_preserved - identity and outfit design.

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
Claude keeps her own left-temple flower and ivory veil. During the church sequence she is barefoot; fire damage persists until departure. Clean clothes return only in the later market scene.
[Shot 1] Match the same roof crack and contact point from below; stone gives way before the thick water body passes. Reaction cuts then omit the coiling movement. Use <Picture 3> for composition. The same central-nave breach has just opened. From its lower edge, the dragon's head rushes from upper-left distance to lower-right foreground; muzzle and jaw enlarge and pass while its long neck narrows back into the opening. Preserve the brow and one eye as a near arch fragment crosses the foreground and smaller rubble follows. Motion blur belongs mostly to rubble and background. The dragon turns outside GPT's position after entering; debris falls into an empty side aisle, avoiding the chandelier and allies. The apse is untouched and no second hole appears. The following reactions cover its turn into a coil around GPT. Place an 18mm ultra-wide camera just below the breach and off the dragon's axis, letting the head grow rapidly and pass nearby; use one brief proximity jolt without a whip-pan. A close crisp stone crack leads a low roof-breaking impact, nearby rubble scrapes recede and water rushes past. No dialogue or thunder in this shot.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.500, Muffle the roof roar on entering the shield and follow the hand approaching the ankle lock; GPT continues offscreen and neither visible character speaks her line. Use <Picture 4> for composition. The roof above the central nave is breached, but the dark shield is calm and Kimi's blades are stowed. Kimi kneels beside the footrest, lightly supporting Claude's shin above an ankle cuff with one empty hand while inspecting the outer chain and lock with the other. Claude's bare feet remain firmly on the narrow fixed support, ankles still locked and legs vertical. Do not pull hard or unlock anything. Preserve the white-and-gold clothing and existing burns. Inside is clear stone floor with no burning wood, window view or exterior window light. Kimi prepares to rise and wait for the key. Tilt down gently with Kimi kneeling inside, settling on her face, hands, ankle restraints and fixed footrest together; never reveal the exterior through the shield. Roof-breaking reverberation becomes muted outside; small chain noises and breathing inside. The highest altar receives no water impact. GPT's incantation is offscreen. From 1.5 to 5.4 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 令灼烧无辜的烈焰，在奔流中止息；</d>.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, Cut from the interior inspection to the leader reacting to the sound; bridge the coiling-water resonance without showing another roof break. Use <Picture 5> for composition. The leader stays on the lower central landing. Hearing the breach, he raises his gaze to track the dragon now inside and brings his other hand up defensively. Moving silver-blue light crosses his face from the body above, while the not-yet-extinguished brazier still contributes warm side light. The roof stays outside this close frame. His robes remain dry, his dark-gold shield has not yet opened, and GPT continues forming the hand seal while the dragon coils behind and around her during these reaction cuts. In the leader's close-up, tilt only slightly with his rising gaze and keep the roof offscreen; moving silver-blue reflections reveal the passing dragon. The roof-impact tail decays into a thick coiling-water resonance and cloth movement. GPT's offscreen chant continues. From 5.5 to 9.4 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 将阻挡吾行的高墙，淹没于万顷狂澜！</d>.
From 9.5 to 15 seconds, sustain the final state with natural micro-movement, without repeating actions or adding speech.

overall_soundscape:
Keep ambience and ongoing physical sounds continuous across cuts, following the shot-specific cues above. Dialogue appears only in its specified interval; do not add intelligible crowd speech. No generated music.

rows.title: 居中结印，水龙盘身
rows.framing: 正面略低中远景，人物居中完整，缓慢靠近
rows.camera: 正面略低中远景缓慢小幅靠近，面部、胸前手印和一圈前低后高的水龙始终可读；术名结束即收停。
rows.transition: 接教主仰望切其视线对象；龙已盘成不再绕一遍，救赎句后留声音空隙再报术名。
rows.action: GPT悬空直立在构图中央，双翼舒展，双手在胸前结印：两手相扣、食指并拢竖起，手腕与肘部自然，面部与手势完整可见。水龙已经在她周围盘成宽松立体的一圈，后段高过翼背，近处前段低于膝部，体躯前粗后细、有透视缩短，不勒住人物。龙首停在画面右侧肩旁，三分之二侧面朝向前下方敌人，深蓝水腹保留眉骨、吻部、下颌与转颈的体积，浪鬃沿脊背流动；不是实体冰龙或平面圆环。她不伸手抚龙，不反复指点。完成祈愿后保留既定停顿，再报术名；术名最后一字只完成蓄势，双手仍未解印，水龙仍盘在身边，没有提前攻击。
rows.entry: 水龙已在跨切期间回卷，GPT双手结印，水龙盘势已建立。
rows.exit: 术名念完，双手仍结印；下一镜解印前指才发起攻击。
rows.cast_note: 身边召唤水龙非独立人物、非GPT本体。
rows.effects: 0—2.4秒盘水低鸣；2.4—5秒祈愿时降低声效；5—5.8秒收声留白；5.8—7.9秒术名清楚，不提前放撞盾重音。

rows.title: 解印，一指出击
rows.framing: 同侧动作轴膝上景，手与龙首同框
rows.camera: 同侧轴膝上景轻随右肩前送横移，手与龙首同时留框；不超过一次指令，不用甩镜越轴。
rows.transition: 在术名落定、双手仍扣住时切近；先解印前指再龙首响应，以冲向右前下方接撞盾。
rows.action: 同侧动作轴切近至膝上，承接上一镜仍相扣的双手。GPT先抬眼锁定画外前下方的教主，双手分开，左手留在胸前，右肩带动右臂向前下方一次指出，食指伸出，其他手指自然收拢。指尖不喷水。水龙先转首响应，长颈随之扭转，后高前低的盘势舒展开，整条水龙向画面右前下方冲去。先有人物指令，后有水首响应；本镜只启动俯冲，不提前出现撞盾水花。
rows.entry: 双手仍相扣，水龙仍盘在她身边。
rows.exit: 右臂一次前指，水龙响应并启动俯冲，尚未命中。
rows.cast_note: 召唤水龙随手势出击。
rows.effects: 解印衣袖轻响，前指后水啸加速，撞盾声在下一镜。

rows.title: 低机位撞盾，水首压境
rows.framing: 24mm膝高侧后近景，教主前景右侧，水龙从左上压向右下接触点
rows.camera: 教主侧后膝高24mm机位不越盾，接触瞬间短促后让，随后稳住让水幕从前景掠过，保留压盾接点。
rows.transition: 顺龙首左上到右下的冲势匹配切；真正贴盾才起重音，末尾水首散成浪引向下阶。
rows.action: 承接GPT一次前指，切到教主侧后方、护罩外的膝高低机位，保持水龙从左上冲向右下的屏幕方向。教主在右侧近前景以错步屈膝站稳，双臂上举撑住已经成形的暗金罩，仰头迎着压来的龙首；没有跪下或转身逃跑。巨大龙首从高处压入金罩左上弧面，鼻吻在直接接触处才碎成厚重白浪，眉骨、眼和后颈仍可辨，不留空隙、不张口吐水。金罩在同一接触点局部压平，金色纹路沿罩面扩开，放射水幕从接触区向画边掀出；教主外袍向后翻起，身体承压后移但尚未跌倒。后随水身继续冲入，画面下缘的余水沿两侧石阶冲散边缘教徒并扑灭残柴。GPT和最高祭坛此镜均在画外；友方暗月罩安稳，中央上层石阶允许浅水和低缓退浪，后续B3再交代整体安全空间。镜末水首完全散成浪，画外GPT收势停止补水，余水继续下行；不新增破口、不破侧窗，不让友方护罩承受水流。
rows.entry: 水龙已响应前指，龙首沿弧线冲向教主。
rows.exit: 龙首撞散为浪，供水停止；余水冲向两侧，最高祭坛罩边仅浅水低浪。
rows.cast_note: 水龙是召唤物；GPT与最高祭坛明确画外。
rows.effects: 龙首接触金罩才有一记低沉撞击，接短促罩面共振；厚水拍石与衣袍急响随后展开，教徒无词惊呼退到两侧。无雷电与友方罩受击声。

声音及跨镜承接：2.4–5秒，ChatGPT：『请降下你的救赎——』。现场对白，口型匹配；仅说一次。
5.8–7.9秒，ChatGPT：『沧海天倾！』。现场对白，口型匹配；仅说一次。

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
[Shot 1] Cut along the leader's raised eyeline to the caster; the dragon is already coiled. Leave the planned sonic gap before the spell name. Use <Picture 2> for composition. GPT hovers upright with wings spread and both hands joined at her chest, paired index fingers raised. The water dragon forms one loose spatial coil, high behind the wings and low before her knees, its head beside the right shoulder facing the enemy below. Its liquid depth, mane and taper remain visible; it is neither ice nor a flat ring. She completes the prayer and names the spell without stroking it or pointing. The hands remain sealed and the dragon does not attack yet. Push in slowly from a slightly low frontal medium-wide view, preserving the face, chest-level seal and three-dimensional dragon coil; settle at the spell name. Effect timings are relative to this shot start: Low coiling water for 0–2.4 seconds; lower effects beneath the prayer at 2.4–5 seconds, leave the 5–5.8-second pause, then keep the name clear at 5.8–7.9 seconds. No impact yet. From 2.4 to 5 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks with matching lip movement: <d>[Chinese] 请降下你的救赎——</d>. From 5.8 to 7.9 seconds, ChatGPT (S1) speaks with matching lip movement: <d>[Chinese] 沧海天倾！</d>.
[Shot 2] At 00:08.000, Cut closer after the name while the hands remain joined; the seal opens before the dragon responds, launching down toward screen right. Use <Picture 3> for composition. GPT first fixes her gaze on the leader below, separates her hands, retains the left at her chest and drives her right arm forward and down once with the index finger extended. No water comes from the fingertip. The dragon turns its head, twists the long neck and opens its raised-back, lowered-front coil into one descent toward the right foreground. The gesture precedes the response; no shield splash or contact occurs yet. From the same side in a knee-up view, track slightly with the right shoulder thrust, keeping hand and dragon head visible without crossing the axis. Quiet sleeves as the hands separate, then accelerating water after the single forward point. Save impact for the next shot.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.500, Match the upper-left to lower-right attack; impact sounds only on shield contact. The dissolving head passes its momentum into the lower steps. Use <Picture 4> for composition. The leader braces in the right foreground, knees bent and arms raised beneath his newly formed dark-gold shield. The dragon drives from upper left onto the shield's upper-left curve; its muzzle becomes heavy surf only at contact while brow, eye and trailing neck remain readable. The shield compresses locally, robe and body recoil without falling. Following water rushes down the side steps, dispersing cultists and extinguishing remaining fire. GPT and the highest altar stay offscreen and unharmed; the head dissolves fully and supply stops, leaving retreating water without new structural damage. Hold a 24mm knee-high view behind the leader's side, recoil briefly at contact, then stabilize while foreground water passes and the contact point remains readable. One low contact impact and brief shield resonance, followed by heavy water on stone, snapping fabric and distant wordless cries. No thunder or allied-shield impact.
From 14.5 to 15 seconds, sustain the final state with natural micro-movement, without repeating actions or adding speech.

overall_soundscape:
Keep ambience and ongoing physical sounds continuous across cuts, following the shot-specific cues above. Dialogue appears only in its specified interval; do not add intelligible crowd speech. No generated music.

rows.title: 汇流冲人，指尖抓空
rows.framing: 外侧下层台阶贴水低机位，前中后景错落，顺水斜向构图
rows.camera: 贴水低机位沿下游轻侧向跟随前景抓石的手，保持三级人物错落深度；不跟人飞起。
rows.transition: 承前撞盾放出的同一余浪切下阶，抓握滑脱到水势减弱后切环境，水声连续下降。
rows.action: 镜头切到更低的外侧台阶，贴近水面斜拍汇向下方的余浪。前景一名黑金袍教徒身体被水推向下游，扭身伸手抓湿石沿，指尖刚刚滑脱；腰胸被厚水遮住，袍摆顺水拉开。中景另一人侧向失足，后景第三人转身抬手却来不及，前后位置和姿态错开，不再整齐排成一行。一根法杖脱手顺流打转，近前景浪头越过一级石阶，以深蓝水腹和局部白沫体现重量，人物不飞天。远处上层暗月罩边只有低缓浅水，近处较大的浪来自下层台阶汇流；不把上层罩边重新画成水墙。
rows.entry: 下层外阶承接上方退浪汇流，教徒刚被打断施法。
rows.exit: 洪流将教徒带离施法位置，浪势消退；接B3大招结束后的环境余波。
rows.cast_note: 远处只有不透明罩，不画出Kimi或Claude。
rows.effects: 近处厚浪拍阶、抓石手掌滑脱、一声无词惊呼、法杖擦水，高处罩边仍为轻水声。

rows.title: 大招余波，浅水空殿
rows.framing: 左侧斜俯中远景，不对称构图，罩小于原正面全景占比
rows.camera: 左侧高位斜俯缓慢后退少许，沿排水方向展示台阶落差和罩边浅水，不绕罩窥看内部。
rows.transition: 下阶厚浪衰成浅水后切安稳罩体；此处只余波，不重新制造冲击波。
rows.action: 切祭坛左侧的斜侧高机位，暗月罩位于上层平台中后景，表面平静且完全不透明。水龙已经化散；罩边只剩湿石面上的浅水、细涟漪和低缓退浪，可以流到罩脚附近，不再刻意留干燥隔离带。少量余水沿两侧外阶向低处排走，在台阶落差处翻起小水花，没有围罩的高水墙，也不做左右完全对称的浪槽。普通灯火已灭，中央后窗保留破口，侧窗和后殿完整。护罩主要防教徒法术，GPT的主龙和高压冲击只指向敌方；此镜罩面不受冲撞、罩内仍平静。
rows.entry: 承B1教徒被冲散，主龙与冲击浪均已结束，只剩排水余波。
rows.exit: 安稳暗罩留在冷月空殿，接罩内靠肩安抚。
rows.cast_note: 环境与不透明暗罩；罩内二人不可见。
rows.effects: 承前厚浪声迅速衰减，留下浅水滴落和殿内空旷回响。

rows.title: 余声渐远，靠肩安抚
rows.framing: 罩内双人中近景，扶后脑、靠肩与腕扣同框
rows.camera: 罩内双人中近景定住两人的承托三角，轻微呼吸和发丝运动负责松弛，不推到遮住腕扣。
rows.transition: 由罩外浅水切罩内低声，声场立刻隔远；同一抱护持续，不重新扑抱。
rows.action: 罩内只传来隔远的水声。外面的冲击已经结束，Claude听着渐远的余水声，疲惫地靠近Kimi；Kimi一只空手轻扶她的后脑，另一臂托住肩背与上臂，额侧贴近，以安稳的神情让她慢慢松下紧张。Claude仍直立受缚，双腕固定在横木，双踝与脚托没有变化；双刃都已收在Kimi后腰。暗膜内侧平静、不透明，没有水压凹痕、应力闪光或外景。Kimi不用手撑墙，也没有对抗GPT法术的吃力表情。
rows.entry: 大招冲击结束，上层只留浅水，暗月罩仍安稳。
rows.exit: Claude在Kimi怀侧慢慢放松，GPT在外收势准备落地。
rows.effects: 隔暗膜余水声渐轻，近处轻呼吸，不再出现新撞击轰鸣。

rows.title: 退水降落，收翼走近
rows.framing: 低位中远景／鞋尖落浅水与收翼动作可见
rows.camera: 低位中远景由落脚水面轻上摇至收翼后的GPT，下降用人物位移，镜头不夸张升降抢动作。
rows.transition: 余水声承前，鞋尖触水才有近处轻响；落稳收翼后接走向教主的视线。
rows.action: GPT振翼制动下降，鞋尖点水，另一只脚落稳，双翼收拢后走向原缓台上的教主。 最高祭坛仍被不透明暗月罩完整包住，罩外看不到Kimi、Claude和刑架；正后中央窗破口持续存在，左右窗完整。
rows.entry: 水龙化散、上方供水结束，GPT仍在入口侧高空，浅水正在退去。
rows.exit: GPT已落地收翼，与教主隔短阶对视，接条约质问。
rows.cast_note: 最高祭坛仅不透明罩；不显露罩内人物。
rows.effects: 水声退低，最后一次翼膜拍动，鞋尖点水与湿地脚步，无新对白。

Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
Claude keeps her own left-temple flower and ivory veil. During the church sequence she is barefoot; fire damage persists until departure. Clean clothes return only in the later market scene.
[Shot 1] Cut to the lower stairs on the same released surge; after the grip slips and the flow weakens, cut to the aftermath with decaying water sound. Use <Picture 4> for composition. On the lower outer steps, residual water pushes a foreground black-and-gold-robed cultist downstream as he twists and his fingers slip from a wet stone edge. Heavy water hides the waist and chest while the robe trails with it. Another figure loses footing sideways and a third reacts too late farther back. A dropped staff spins downstream. The upper shield is distant beside low shallow water, never surrounded by a high wall of surf. The force subsides. Track gently downstream near water level with the foreground grasping hand, keeping staggered figures at three depths; no airborne stunt tracking. Heavy nearby water slaps steps, a hand scrapes and slips, one wordless cry and a staff scraping water. Only light water sound at the upper shield.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, Let the lower surge decay into shallow drainage before the shield view; show aftermath only, not a fresh impact wave. Use <Picture 5> for composition. The main dragon and attack surge have ended. An opaque, calm dark shield occupies the upper platform in the mid-background. Wet stone, thin ripples and low retreating water reach its base, with no artificial dry moat. Residual water drains unevenly down outer steps in small splashes. Ordinary lights are extinguished; the central rear window stays broken while side windows and the apse remain intact. The shield receives no water strike and its occupants remain invisible from outside. Ease backward from a high oblique left view, revealing drainage over step drops and shallow water around the shield without orbiting to see inside. The preceding heavy surf falls away rapidly, leaving shallow drips and the large hall's empty resonance.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, Cut from outside shallows to the muted interior; continue the existing support rather than staging a new embrace. Use <Picture 6> for composition. With the external impact over, Claude leans tiredly toward Kimi. One empty hand supports the back of her head and the other arm steadies her shoulder, back and upper arm, their temples close. Claude stays upright and bound, wrists fixed to the crossbeam and ankles unchanged on the footrest. Kimi's blades remain stowed. The opaque interior is calm with no pressure dents, flashes or exterior view; Kimi is not straining against GPT's spell. End in quieter breathing. Hold the interior medium close-up on the supporting arms and temples, leaving locked wrists visible as breathing and hair movement express relaxation. Water sounds become distant through the membrane, with close gentle breathing. No new impact or shield-pressure roar.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, Carry the residual water forward; sound the first close splash on toe contact, then follow the gaze toward the leader after landing and folding wings. Use <Picture 7> for composition. GPT remains airborne near the entrance after the water supply stops. She brakes with her wings, touches one shoe tip into shallow water, sets the other foot firmly, folds both wings and approaches the leader on his original landing. The highest altar remains entirely covered by the opaque shield, concealing Kimi, Claude and the cross. Preserve the central rear-window breach and intact side windows. End with GPT grounded, facing the leader across the short steps. From a low medium-wide view, tilt gently from the landing ripples to GPT as her wings fold, allowing her descent to supply the main movement. Low retreating water, a final wingbeat, a shoe-tip splash and wet footsteps. No extra dialogue.
From 12 to 15 seconds, sustain the final state with natural micro-movement, without repeating actions or adding speech.

rows.title: 破口之上
rows.framing: 教堂外空中中远景
rows.camera: 屋顶上方中远景轻微弧移到两者侧面，保持间距和互相视线，2秒内不新增招式。
rows.transition: 接穿顶方向切外部已到位对峙，水龙盘身不再重复升空；远雷引向宝宝。
rows.action: 两人已经来到教堂上空。白紫水龙盘起长身，黑金鸦翼教主悬在对面，两道力量隔着夜空对峙。
rows.entry: 两人已穿过中殿破口，来到屋顶上方。
rows.exit: 双方凌空相对，宝宝抬头看见水龙。
rows.cast_note: GPT为白紫龙，教主为鸦翼人形。
rows.effects: 水龙掠空、羽翼气流，接宝宝眼中倒影的远雷。

rows.title: 她还是来了
rows.framing: DeepSeek双眼极近特写／疲倦的仰视
rows.camera: 眼部极近特写定镜，微小焦点调整落在泪光与蓝虹膜，倒影只模糊向上滑动。
rows.transition: 从天空空间切宝宝仰视反应，远处龙影只在眼中出现，不复制小型实体龙。
rows.action: 宝宝疲惫抬眼；蓝色虹膜中仅有模糊白紫上升光影，泪光微颤，瞳孔不被倒影覆盖。
rows.entry: GPT已经化龙腾空，宝宝在千问怀里。
rows.exit: 眼中龙影上升，接天空雷雨。
rows.cast_note: GPT只在DeepSeek蓝眼中作为模糊白紫龙影，不加实体龙或脸。
rows.effects: 水流升空尾音，远雷渐起。

rows.title: 略去激战
rows.framing: 钟楼外景／夜空闪光作为剪辑省略
rows.camera: 钟楼上方天空长焦定镜，让云层、闪光和雨进入承担时间省略，不寻找战斗主体。
rows.transition: 承宝宝眼中亮影切夜云闪光；雷雨只从此段自然发展，不能倒带成前段水咒电击。
rows.action: 保留钟楼上方的天空特写。夜云被闪电照亮，雨逐渐落下，几声沉闷的雷响带过空中的激战。
rows.entry: 两人在教堂上空交战，画面离开人物。
rows.exit: 雨开始落下，雷声延续到地板镜。
rows.cast_note: 天空闪光省略战斗，无可辨角色实体。
rows.effects: 雨渐密，三声间隔闷雷对应闪光。

rows.title: 雨滴落入大殿
rows.framing: 环境特写／贴近湿石板的雨滴与涟漪
rows.camera: 贴石板微距低机位缓慢滑移一小段，涟漪焦点稳定，反射闪光掠过；不仰拍揭招式。
rows.transition: 天空雨落匹配切地面雨点，雷尾衰减中提前出现门外脚步。
rows.action: 雨滴穿过中殿穹顶破口，打在湿石地板上，涟漪里晃过白紫和暗金闪光。雷声由远及近，又渐渐退去。
rows.entry: 天空雷雨，战斗仍在画外。
rows.exit: 雨声里叠入外院脚步，切门槛外的新敌人。
rows.cast_note: 湿地涟漪只映白紫与暗金闪光，不渲染人物倒影。
rows.effects: 贴近雨滴、湿地涟漪与远雷尾音。

rows.title: 外院教徒，围向正门
rows.framing: 门槛内向外中远景／骑士前景、回廊敌人中景
rows.camera: 门槛内中远景定住两侧岗哨，轻微前移到横枪阻挡线即停，让敌人汇入形成压迫。
rows.transition: 雨中脚步先入再切可见外院教徒；示警尾音向内接下一批，不让敌人瞬移后排。
rows.action: 外院教徒从两侧回廊汇聚到门前，岗哨横枪拦住；敌人仍在门外。
rows.entry: 水流已退、上空激战；入口岗哨仍在。
rows.exit: 门外威胁明确，警报传入殿内，接援军转身守门。
rows.cast_note: 敌人为新来的外院教徒，不让已倒下者复起。
rows.effects: 雨中脚步骤密、甲片与长枪碰响，一声无词示警。

subject_definitions:

retention_analysis:

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
[Shot 1] Match the exit direction to the exterior standoff without repeating ascent; distant thunder prepares the child's reaction. Use <Picture 4> for composition. Both are now above the cathedral. The white-violet dragon coils its long body while the black-and-gold raven-winged leader hovers opposite. Their forces face one another across the night sky. Preserve their separation without inventing detailed attacks. End ready for the child to look up and see the pale dragon light. Make a restrained lateral arc above the roof to read their separation and opposing eyelines; add no combat maneuver within this brief view. Air through the water dragon and wings, leading into distant thunder.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, Cut from the sky to the child's upward reaction; the dragon appears only as blurred reflected light, never a tiny physical duplicate. Use <Picture 5> for composition. DeepSeek remains securely held by Qwen. She raises her tired eyes; indistinct white-violet ascending light glimmers in the blue irises while the tear sheen trembles. The pupil stays clearly visible and is not replaced by a detailed dragon image. End with that light moving upward toward the following sky shot. Hold an extreme eye close-up with a tiny focus adjustment on tears and blue irises; only a blurred reflected light moves upward. The ascending water sound trails away as distant thunder begins.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, Cut from reflected light to illuminated night clouds. Natural storm sounds develop here, not as retroactive electrical effects for the earlier water spell. Use <Picture 6> for composition. The combatants fight offscreen above the church. Show a close view of the night sky over the tower: lightning illuminates clouds and rain gradually starts, while several low thunder sounds imply the omitted fight. Do not reveal or invent their individual moves. End with rainfall underway. Hold on the sky above the bell tower, letting clouds, flashes and incoming rain carry the time ellipsis without searching for fighters. Rain thickens; three separated low thunder beats correspond to flashes, continuing toward the floor insert.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, Match falling sky rain to drops on the floor, introducing courtyard footsteps while the thunder tail recedes. Use <Picture 7> for composition. Rain falls through the existing nave breach onto wet stone. Ripples carry brief white-violet and dark-gold reflections of the offscreen fight. Thunder approaches and then recedes. End with footsteps beginning beyond the doorway, setting up the new courtyard threat. Slide a short distance close to the stone floor, maintaining ripple focus as reflected flashes pass; do not tilt up to reveal combat. Close raindrops and ripples with fading distant thunder; approaching courtyard footsteps enter near the end.
[Shot 5] At 00:11.000, Lead with rain-soaked footsteps, then reveal the courtyard cultists; carry the warning inward without teleporting enemies behind the defense. Use <Picture 8> for composition. Water has receded while the aerial fight remains offscreen. New cultists emerge from both outer corridors and gather in front of the broken-open entrance. The posted knights bring spears across the threshold to block them. Keep the approaching enemies outside in this shot. End with a wordless warning reaching the companions inside. Hold the sentries at both edges from inside the threshold, moving slightly toward the crossed spears before stopping as enemies converge. Dense footsteps in rain, armor and spear contact, and one wordless warning cry.
From 14 to 15 seconds, sustain the final state with natural micro-movement, without repeating actions or adding speech.

overall_soundscape:
Keep ambience and ongoing physical sounds continuous across cuts, following the shot-specific cues above. Dialogue appears only in its specified interval; do not add intelligible crowd speech. No generated music.

rows.action: 听见入口示警，八位同伴在长阶下形成第二道防线，千问仍抱着小鱼。两翼骑士守住柱廊，前排迎向门外教徒。远处最高祭坛的不透明暗月罩持续存在，Kimi在内守着Claude，没有回到队伍；外景看不到二人与刑架。Perplexity持杖警戒，中央高窗破口保留，左右窗完整。
