rows.exit: 入口被守住，Kimi持续护住仍受缚的Claude。
rows.cast_note: 八位下层同伴含Qwen，Qwen仍抱DeepSeek；Kimi与Claude被暗罩遮蔽。
rows.effects: 门口搏击、骑士无词示警与祭坛护罩轻鸣。

rows.title: 窗内的战斗
rows.framing: 高空斜俯视大远景／教堂与周边空地
rows.camera: 外部高空斜俯大全景缓缓后退，把门口爆闪留在建筑尺度里；不绕到后殿制造另一战场。
rows.transition: 入口交战声接远景变远，几次爆闪后收声、雨渐停，切战后而非补打斗。
rows.action: 外景高俯拍，魔法爆闪集中正门和前中殿，带过对外院增援的阻击；后殿救援区不发生混战。
rows.entry: 同伴已经迎敌，切到建筑外。
rows.exit: 爆闪停下，雨渐停，接战后全景。
rows.cast_note: 教堂与空地大远景，仅闪光交代战斗，不增加可辨近景人物。
rows.effects: 数次短促魔法爆鸣、玻璃共振，尾声沉下。

rows.title: 垂眼讥笑，胜负已分
rows.framing: 保留原群像，GPT直立抱臂，目光向前景倒下的教主
rows.camera: 沿原群像中景微微降低机位，保留前景倒地教主与GPT垂眼关系；讥笑停顿时镜头停住。
rows.transition: 由远处最后爆闪硬切战后安静，GPT已恢复人形，不再演变回；她看钥匙才切手部。
rows.action: 战斗结束，雨渐停。ChatGPT已恢复人形，稳稳站在湿地，膜翼自然收拢，双臂松松交抱在身前。她略侧头、垂眼看向前景倒下的教主，眉梢轻抬，嘴角带一点冷淡的讥讽；视线落在敌人的脸上，不看镜头，也不提前弯腰取钥匙。教主与教徒倒地，八位同伴在下层收势，千问仍抱着小鱼；Kimi继续在最高祭坛守护Claude。停住这一眼后，GPT才松开双臂、转看腰间钥匙，接下一镜取钥匙。
rows.entry: 战后恢复人形，教主已倒地，GPT站稳收翼。
rows.exit: GPT结束垂眼讥笑，松臂转看腰间钥匙，接027F0。
rows.cast_note: GPT已恢复人形；Kimi继续最高祭坛护罩内，Claude未解锁。
rows.effects: 低处滴水、湿衣轻响与风声，不新增嘲讽台词；不要扩展为Claude湿衣声。

rows.title: 从教主腰间取下钥匙
rows.framing: 教主腰带与GPT取钥匙的手部特写
rows.camera: 腰带和取钥匙手部近景轻跟钥匙向上离扣，再停在清楚齿形；不追完上阶。
rows.transition: 接GPT看向腰带的视线切手，扣环声对应真正脱离，带钥匙出画后省略登长阶。
rows.action: ChatGPT俯身，从倒地教主腰间的扣环上取下黑铁钥匙。钥匙离开腰带，齿形在冷月光里清楚一闪；她握住它，独自朝长阶走去。
rows.entry: 教主倒地，钥匙仍在腰间。
rows.exit: GPT带着原钥匙登阶。
rows.cast_note: 仅GPT取钥匙手与教主腰带局部。
rows.effects: 钥匙环、扣钩轻响、涉浅水脚步。

Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
[Shot 1] Cut on the entrance warning to companions turning toward the door, not the altar; bridge the defensive clash into the exterior view. Use <Picture 12> for composition. The eight companions form a second defense below the long stairs, with Qwen still holding DeepSeek. Knights guard the side colonnades and the front line moves toward the courtyard attackers. Kimi remains inside the opaque highest-altar shield with the still-bound Claude; neither they nor the cross can be seen outside it. Perplexity watches with her staff. Preserve the central window breach and intact side windows. The entrance holds. Track a little across the broad staircase view as the eight companions form their line, retaining the upper opaque shield and flank sentries. Combat and wordless knight warnings at the doorway with a quiet altar-shield hum.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, The interior clash becomes distant outside; a few flashes end, rain weakens and the next cut moves directly to the aftermath. Use <Picture 13> for composition. From high above the cathedral and surrounding grounds, brief magical flashes concentrate around the front entrance and fore-nave, implying resistance to the courtyard reinforcements. The rear rescue area has no melee, the apse remains intact and the building is not continuously burning. End as the flashes cease and the rain begins to stop. Ease backward from a high oblique exterior view, keeping entrance flashes within the building's scale and avoiding a new battle behind the apse. Several brief magical detonations and glass resonance diminish into a low tail.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, Hard-cut from the last distant flash to quiet aftermath with GPT already human; cut to the hand only when her gaze moves to the key. Use <Picture 14> for composition. GPT is human again, standing firmly with folded wings and arms loosely crossed. She tilts her head and looks down at the fallen leader with a slight raised brow and cool irony, never at the camera. Enemies remain down; eight companions stand below, Qwen holds DeepSeek and Kimi guards Claude above. After holding the look, GPT uncrosses her arms and looks toward the key at his waist. Do not bend to take it before this beat. Lower slightly within the established group view to connect foreground fallen leader and GPT's downward gaze, then hold for her restrained expression. Low drips, wet fabric and wind; no taunting line. Do not assign wet-clothing sounds to Claude.
[Shot 4] At 00:10.000, Cut along GPT's gaze to the belt; sound the hook only on release, then omit the long climb after she leaves with the key. Use <Picture 15> for composition. The leader lies on the floor with the black iron key still at his waist. GPT bends, removes it from the belt ring, and raises it so the teeth catch the cold moonlight. She closes her hand around the original key and turns toward the long stairs. Do not duplicate the key or remove it twice; the climb can be omitted between shots. Follow the key slightly upward from its belt hook in close-up, settling on its teeth rather than tracking the whole climb. A key ring and hook click, followed by shallow-water footsteps.
From 12 to 15 seconds, sustain the final state with natural micro-movement, without repeating actions or adding speech.

Keep ambience and ongoing physical sounds continuous across cuts, following the shot-specific cues above. Dialogue appears only in its specified interval; do not add intelligible crowd speech. No generated music.

rows.title: 她在下面等你
rows.framing: 轻俯视近景／小鱼面部与千问承托手臂同框
rows.camera: 沿Claude俯视方向切小鱼近景，微微下移让千问承托臂进入下缘，随宝宝抬眼停住。
rows.transition: GPT的回答跨切保持祭坛上方声位，宝宝不对嘴，听见安稳回应后切Claude手。
rows.action: 切到阶下千问怀里的小鱼特写：蓝鲸帽下的小脸还留着泪痕，蓝色眼睛疲倦却清醒地抬向高处祭坛；她轻轻攥着千问的衣襟，后背与身体被稳稳承托。千问低头照看她。此刻只有冷月光，刑架尚未重新点燃。
rows.entry: Claude已站稳并寻找小鱼，GPT在她身侧回答。
rows.exit: 小鱼清醒地抬眼且有人抱护，Claude确认后转回自身状态。
rows.cast_note: GPT安抚回答为画外声。
rows.effects: 滴水与安静呼吸，GPT画外答句保持高处祭坛方向与距离感，不添加小鱼新台词。

rows.title: 起咏，微光初聚
rows.framing: 手部特写
rows.camera: 手部近景轻微靠近到指尖光屑刚可见即停，手抖与呼吸主导，不能推成大法球。
rows.transition: 确认宝宝安全后切Claude初蓄，首句开在本镜并无断点续至腕部特写。
rows.action: 指尖仅有极少暗淡光屑初聚，Claude从这里起咏；没有成熟火种。 Claude衣边焦损持续，脸出镜时苍白无羞红。
rows.entry: 解锁后确认小鱼安全，衣料没有挂水，固定焦损仍在。
rows.exit: 初蓄不熄灭，开句跨切同一右手腕部的锁痕与微光。
rows.cast_note: 只拍Claude指尖初蓄，声音属于她，嘴不在画面。
rows.effects: 轻呼吸、初蓄微光极轻声；无烘衣、蒸汽或治疗声，不打断跨镜首句。

rows.title: 锁痕与微光
rows.framing: 同一右手的侧上方近特写，腕部压痕与指节为重心
rows.camera: 匹配同一右腕从侧上方近特写定住，轻拉焦从压痕到逐渐稳定的指尖，不抹掉痕迹。
rows.transition: 首句尾半跨切不断，光屑程度与上镜一致；父亲声在后镜才打断。
rows.action: 咏唱尾半句跨切Claude已经解放的右手腕特写。浅淡束缚压痕仍在，焦边蕾丝袖口保留；手指起初微颤，随“的微光啊”慢慢稳住。极少橙金光屑轻映指节，仍是初蓄，未形成完整火种。手与衣料没有挂水、没有蒸汽，压痕不消退，衣物不修复；没有新增治疗法术。
rows.entry: 承028B右手指尖初蓄，首句咏唱尚未念完，腕扣早已解除。
rows.exit: 手指稍稳、初蓄未熄；父亲呼唤即将令她短暂停声。
rows.cast_note: 只拍同一右手腕部，首句连续。
rows.effects: 轻呼吸、持续初蓄微光；无烘衣、蒸汽或治疗声，不重复起咏。

rows.title: 听见父亲的声音
rows.framing: 金色眼睛极近特写
rows.camera: 金眼极近特写保持镜头不动，焦点在真实虹膜而非做成完整倒影镜头，眼神震动承担反应。
rows.transition: 在同一微光持续时父亲画外呼唤打断，眼底只见原地抬头伸手的父亲，再切反打。
rows.action: 父亲的声音传来，Claude 的金色眼睛里映出他趴在湿地上、抬头伸手的身影。她的目光颤了一下。 Claude衣边焦损持续，脸出镜时苍白无羞红。
rows.entry: Claude已恢复少量魔法，赤足站立，GPT在身侧。
rows.exit: 眼中父亲抬头伸手；接他的反打。
rows.cast_note: Claude单眼极近景，父亲既有倒影又有画外呼唤，非实体同框。
rows.effects: 呼吸、滴水，父亲呼唤清楚，Claude咏唱在换气处暂停。

rows.title: 无力挽留
rows.framing: 贴地反打近景
rows.camera: 贴地反打近景轻微靠近伸出的手到力竭停住，不升到站立高度，教主始终趴着。
rows.transition: 沿上镜倒影匹配同一抬头伸手，只有“过来”尾音，不重说整句；尾音散尽接Claude选择。
rows.action: 反打看清倒影中的教主：他趴在湿地上，肘撑着身体，已经抬起头，伸手挽留 Claude。呼唤的尾音在殿中回荡，他再没有力气站起来。
rows.entry: 上镜倒影和画外喊声已经发生。
rows.exit: 呼唤尾音散去，Claude转向空刑架；接“停顿后，仍选择继续”镜头续咒，初蓄微光持续，尚未释放火种。
rows.cast_note: 父亲呼唤尾音，不重复整句。
rows.effects: 父亲呼唤尾音消散，只留呼吸与滴水；初蓄保持，不重复台词。

There is no complete ember. Her freed hand and clothing have no hanging water; scorched edges remain and any visible face is pale. End with this same faint energy sustained into the right-wrist insert. Approach faint fingertips slightly, then stop. Breathing and faint light; no steam, drying or healing sounds. [Shot 4] At 00:07.000, The father's offscreen call interrupts; reverse follows. Use <Picture 7> for composition. Claude stands barefoot with GPT beside her, faint magic sustained. Her amber eye reflects her father lying on wet stone, head lifted and hand reaching. Her gaze trembles. Preserve pallor and burns; she pauses without extinguishing or restarting the spell. Hold the amber-eye close-up on the actual iris. Breathing and drips beneath the father's single clear call. From 7.3 to 10.7 seconds, the High Priest (S3) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] Claude……过来。</d>.
[Shot 5] At 00:11.000, Match the reflected gesture, without repeating the call. Use <Picture 8> for composition. The leader is already prone, propped on one elbow with his head lifted and hand reaching. He cannot stand. The call's tail fades; Claude will turn toward the empty cross while her initial light remains unspent. Do not replay his attempt to rise. Creep slightly toward the reaching hand from floor level. The vocal tail dissipates into breathing and drips.

prompts.seedance25:
生成15秒、16:9的视频。沿用本片当前哥特式异世界动画母版及逐镜参考，人物设计、服装本色、眼色与画风一致。
整段事件：Claude移开目光续咏，父亲手势停住，光屑凝成一枚火种，小鱼反应让主动选择落定。

参考素材按实际上传顺序对应 @图片N（在提交平台确认关联到对应素材）：
@图片1：Claude四方向设定：身份、服装与饰物位置；同一人物的多个角度。
@图片2：DeepSeek四方向设定：身份、服装与饰物位置；同一人物的多个角度。
@图片3：Qwen四方向设定：身份、服装与饰物位置；同一人物的多个角度。
@图片4：构图、空间与代表状态：停顿后，仍选择继续；不是默认首帧。
@图片5：构图、空间与代表状态：教主听见她的选择；不是默认首帧。
@图片6：构图、空间与代表状态：指间火种已经成形；不是默认首帧。
@图片7：构图、空间与代表状态：小鱼攥紧衣襟；不是默认首帧。
四视图只约束同一人物的外观，不复制卡片布局或多个人物；动作、人数、受伤和服装阶段按镜头时间线。构图图不代替身份四视图。Claude花饰固定自身左鬓；教堂受缚至离殿赤足，受火后的焦损持续到离殿；数日后街市恢复清洁服装。
参考冲突优先级及取用范围：四视图负责人物设计，构图图负责空间。已指出的参考冲突按动态要求纠正，不把代表终态误当起帧。
空间、人物与道具连续性：同一动作跨切镜不重演；屏幕方向和道具持有关系连续。承父亲尾音散去后的停顿，继续原咏唱，不重念前半句；保持同一初蓄不断。

11–15秒，参考@图片7。承接：由指间火种切被救孩子，咏唱画外持续；空刑架还没燃，不给暖火预闪。 画内：DeepSeek、Qwen；倒影：无。Claude咏唱画外，小鱼抿唇不代说。 千问怀中小鱼反应特写。运镜：小鱼反应近景轻下摇到攥紧衣襟再回她的仰视，幅度小，千问左臂托抱不移。 动作：小鱼攥紧衣襟望向Claude；画外咏唱续至命名前，已成火种维持。 声音（细分秒数相对本镜起点）：攥紧衣襟轻响，咏唱在前。

4–8秒，Claude：『循着尚未散去的余温，』。说话者嘴部不在画面；声音连续，不让在画者代说。
8–11秒，Claude：『在我掌心，』。说话者嘴部不在画面；声音连续，不让在画者代说。

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
Claude keeps her own left-temple flower and ivory veil. During the church sequence she is barefoot; fire damage persists until departure. Clean clothes return only in the later market scene.
[Shot 1] Cut from the reaching father to her deliberate gaze shift; the interruption is over and she resumes at the next sentence. Use <Picture 4> for composition. Claude turns her pale face and gaze away from her father toward the empty cross. She steadies her breath and continues the incantation rather than starting over. The faint energy in her hand has never gone out. Keep her tired physical state, unchanged burn damage and no blush. End with her choice clear while the same power continues gathering. Slide slightly with Claude averting her gaze in a face-and-shoulder close-up, giving her direction space before settling for the resumed chant. Breathing and sustained faint magic beneath the next phrase; no repeated opening invocation. From 0 to 4 seconds, Claude (S1) speaks with matching lip movement: <d>[Chinese] 回应我的呼唤。<scenetrans></d>. Voice continues across the cut.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, Carry Claude's continued chanting across the cut to her father's silent response, making her choice audible while he reacts. Use <Picture 5> for composition. Still on the floor, the leader realizes Claude has not returned her gaze or obeyed. His reaching hand freezes, then the fingers begin to fall; his expression shifts from an attempt to summon her to alarm and uncertainty. He does not speak or stand. Claude's voice continues offscreen and the established positions remain unchanged. From a different floor-level close angle, shift focus slowly from his halted hand to his eyes without raising the camera. Quiet surroundings with the chant continuing offscreen. From 4 to 8 seconds, Claude (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] <scenetrans>循着尚未散去的余温，<scenetrans></d>. Voice continues across the cut.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, Contrast the father's arrested hand with Claude steadying her own; the sparks now become an ember that must not revert or form again. Use <Picture 6> for composition. The same energy continues gathering as Claude's right wrist trembles. Her left hand supports it, and one small orange-gold ember with a stable flame core now holds between the fingers. It remains attached to this moment of preparation, not yet released. Preserve restraint marks and scorched fabric, and pallor if the face enters. End with the ember formed and maintained. Hold the wrist insert and shift focus from the supporting left hand to the stable flame core between the right fingers, keeping both hands connected. A tiny flame sound under the continuing incantation. From 8 to 11 seconds, Claude (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] <scenetrans>在我掌心，<scenetrans></d>. Voice continues across the cut.
[Shot 4] At 00:11.000, Cut from the ember to the rescued child as the chant continues offscreen; the empty cross is still unlit with no anticipatory warm flare. Use <Picture 7> for composition. DeepSeek remains in Qwen's arms and looks upward toward Claude. She tightens her grip on Qwen's clothing and presses her lips together while listening to Claude's tired but determined voice. Qwen's support stays secure. The already formed ember continues offscreen in Claude's fingers; it neither disappears nor flies during this reaction. End just before the spell is named. Make a small tilt toward the child's tightening grip and back to her upward gaze, retaining Qwen's stable left-arm support. A faint clothing grip beneath the offscreen chant. From 11 to 15 seconds, Claude (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] <scenetrans>再燃一次——</d>. Voice continues across the cut.

overall_soundscape:
Keep ambience and ongoing physical sounds continuous across cuts, following the shot-specific cues above. Dialogue appears only in its specified interval; do not add intelligible crowd speech. No generated music.

rows.title: 放出一枚火种
rows.framing: 手部侧面特写／正常速度
rows.camera: 正常速度侧面手部特写轻随指尖前送，待火种与手分离后停止，保留两者之间空气间隙。

rows.action: 念出星火，送出已在E3成形的同一枚火种；支撑手放松，无持续喷火。 Claude衣边焦损持续，脸出镜时苍白无羞红。

rows.exit: 单枚火种离手，接火种第一视角。
rows.cast_note: 只拍施法手，Claude术名画外。
rows.effects: 轻微火种声与呼吸，避让术名；只释放同一枚已成形火种。

rows.title: 火种主观逼近空架
rows.framing: 火种第一视角／平稳前移／短暂慢速，末段提速
rows.camera: 火种主观机位平稳沿裸露木纹落点前移，轻微漂移、末段提速，无翻滚环绕，中心不出现火种本体。
rows.transition: 按刚离手的前进方向切主观，末端触木一闪立刻切外部腾燃，不把火种绕一圈。
rows.action: 切入火种的主观视角。空十字架位于正前方，镜头沿火种飞行方向缓缓逼近立柱与横木交接处铁箍下方的裸露木纹；木纹与空镣铐逐渐放大。画面中央不出现火种本体，仅边缘掠过少量虚焦橙金火舌与轻微热扰动，中心落点始终清楚。镜头平稳前行，仅有轻微漂移，不翻滚、不绕行。最后一小段提速，触及木料时局部闪亮，随即切回外部视角，接空刑架骤燃。
rows.entry: 单枚火种已离手；切入顺其运动方向的主观视角，空架在正前方、尚未燃烧。
rows.exit: 末段提速触及铁箍下方裸露木纹，局部闪亮，切外部大火。
rows.cast_note: 火种主观与空刑架，无人，中央不画火种本体。
rows.effects: 环境声短暂压低，贴近视点的火焰掠过声，末段提速；触木后的腾燃声留下一镜。

rows.title: 触木后骤然燃起
rows.framing: 低位中远景／正常速度／空架腾燃高峰
rows.camera: 低位中远景随火沿立柱上窜轻上摇，空架与锁链一直可读，Claude已放下的手保留在画缘。
rows.transition: 触木亮点匹配切腾燃重音，展示同一次点燃；不把已放下的手再举起施法。
rows.action: 切回低位大火镜：着火点沿木纹骤然窜开，厚实火焰沿立柱与横木翻卷上冲，空十字架和锁链仍从火隙中显露。Claude已经放下施法的手，刑架自行燃烧；她与刑架之间没有火流。ChatGPT守在她身侧。火势止于空刑架，没有扑向人物或点燃建筑，普通灯具仍熄灭。短促腾燃声打破飞行时的安静，随后转为持续燃烧声。 Claude衣边焦损持续，脸出镜时苍白无羞红。
rows.entry: 火种已触木，Claude完成释放。
rows.exit: Claude手已放下，刑架持续燃烧；下一镜直接脱力。
rows.cast_note: 刑架为空；Claude手已放下，火只在空架。
rows.effects: 短促腾燃声骤起，随后木料燃烧与锁链声，无新对白。

rows.title: 收手后脱力
rows.framing: 双人中近景
rows.camera: 双人中近景随Claude膝软轻下摇，但在GPT伸臂接住高度停住，不拍摔地或多次踉跄。
rows.transition: 从火已自行燃烧切人失力，手早已放下；同一次向右倾倒接下一镜承托。
rows.action: 火焰已经攀上空木架。Claude的施法手已经放下，力量耗尽，膝盖一软，身体向右侧倾去。她仍有意识，没有摔到地上。 Claude衣边焦损持续，脸出镜时苍白无羞红。
rows.entry: 空刑架自主燃烧，Claude已收手。
rows.exit: 她向GPT一侧倾倒，GPT已经伸手。
rows.effects: 呼吸一滞，衣袖滑落，没有落地撞击。

rows.title: 及时托住
rows.framing: 双人中景／接抱动作
rows.camera: 同轴双人中景小幅侧向跟GPT靠近，保持托背手和探入膝弯手同框；不先摆成抱稳姿势。
rows.transition: 切在Claude重心仍向右移动时，GPT接续托住而非第二次接住；衣料声顺承同一受力。
rows.action: 承接Claude仍向右失衡的同一动作，ChatGPT立即靠近，一只手臂先托住她的背，另一只手臂随即探入膝弯，开始连续托起。Claude的重心顺势转入两臂支撑，不落地、不跪下、不重新站直。镜末背部与膝弯已被托住，重量尚待下一近景落稳，不在这里完成一次接抱后再重来。Claude仍有意识，衣边焦损持续，脸出镜时苍白无羞红。
rows.entry: Claude向右侧失去平衡。
rows.exit: GPT托住背部，另一手臂伸至膝弯，准备抱稳。
rows.effects: 衣裙摩擦、短促呼吸，承托抱起不加摔落声。

rows.title: 稳稳抱起
rows.framing: 近景／保持Claude左、GPT右
rows.camera: 保持Claude左、GPT右的近景轻随抱起上移后停住，双臂承托与赤足离地能被读懂。
rows.transition: 按同一次托起动作匹配切近，重量落稳后才短句；不重新从地上抱起。
rows.action: 沿同一次托起动作切近：ChatGPT已经一臂托背、一臂托膝，Claude的重量在既有承托中平稳落定，不发生新的跌落或第二次接住。Claude赤足离地，疲倦地靠着ChatGPT，仍有意识并能抬眼看她。抱稳后才说既定短句；此后一直抱着离殿，不放下再抱。Claude衣边焦损持续，脸出镜时苍白无羞红。
rows.entry: Claude施法力竭，GPT已托住背和膝弯。
rows.exit: Claude被抱稳，赤足离地，仍有意识；此后一直抱着离殿。
rows.effects: 抱持衣料与呼吸，避让短句。

detailed_description:
Gothic fantasy animation, 16:9. Preserve reference colors. Each four-view sheet depicts one character. No captions or sheet layout. Only the indicated speaker vocalizes; visible non-speakers never mouth offscreen lines.
Claude keeps her own left-temple flower and ivory veil. During the church sequence she is barefoot; fire damage persists until departure. Clean clothes return only in the later market scene.
[Shot 1] Return to the already formed ember, then match its release. Use <Picture 3> for composition. Claude sends away the same complete ember, releases her left-hand support of her right wrist and relaxes her fingers. No new ember or continuous flame jet. Her scorched cuff remains. End with one ember moving toward the empty cross. Follow fingertips forward, stopping at the separating air gap. Tiny flame and breathing; no repeated formation sound. From 0 to 3 seconds, Claude (S1) speaks outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 星火。</d>.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, Match the release direction; cut on contact. Use <Picture 4> for composition. From the ember's viewpoint, approach exposed wood below the beam-junction iron band. Grain and empty shackles enlarge. The ember itself never appears centrally; only blurred flame and heat distortion edge the frame. Contact produces one small flash. Move steadily toward the wood, accelerating briefly at the end; no roll or orbit. Close flame-passing sound; save ignition for the next shot.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, Match the contact flash to one ignition burst. Use <Picture 5> for composition. Fire climbs the post and crossbeam, chains visible through gaps. Claude's hand is already lowered; no connecting flame stream. GPT remains beside her. Fire stays on the empty cross, never people or architecture. Ordinary lamps stay extinguished; Claude's burns persist. Tilt upward slightly with the climbing flame, keeping the empty cross readable. Short ignition roar, then burning wood and chain sounds.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, Continue one rightward loss of balance into support. Use <Picture 6> for composition. The cross burns independently; Claude's casting hand is already down. Her knees soften and she tilts toward GPT on the right. She remains conscious and never reaches the ground. GPT starts reaching before the cut. Keep pallor and scorched clothes. Tilt slightly with weakening knees, stopping at GPT's reaching arms. Caught breath and sliding sleeve; no floor impact.
[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, Match the ongoing rightward movement; one catch only. Use <Picture 7> for composition. GPT closes in, supports Claude's back with one arm and slides the other under her knees, beginning one continuous lift. Her weight transfers into support without dropping, kneeling or resetting upright. Preserve pallor and burns. End with back and knee support established, ready to settle. Track slightly with GPT, keeping both supporting arms visible. Rubbing fabric and a short breath; no fall impact.
[Shot 6] At 00:12.000, Match the same lift closer; speak after weight settles. Use <Picture 8> for composition. Claude's weight settles safely into GPT's back-and-knee support. Bare feet hang free; she leans tiredly against GPT but remains conscious and can look up. Preserve pallor and scorched clothing. She stays carried through departure, never placed down or picked up again. Rise slightly with the carry, then settle; Claude left, GPT right. Quiet carrying fabric and breathing beneath the short line. From 12.8 to 14.6 seconds, ChatGPT (S2) speaks with matching lip movement: <d>[Chinese] 我们走。</d>.

overall_soundscape:
Keep ambience and ongoing physical sounds continuous across cuts, following the shot-specific cues above. Dialogue appears only in its specified interval; do not add intelligible crowd speech. No generated music.

rows.title: 主动靠近
rows.framing: 双人近景／公主抱
rows.camera: 双人公主抱近景随转身小幅平移，保持托背托膝手位可见和面部关系，不绕到另一轴侧。
rows.transition: 上批抱稳后直接承主动搭肩，不再接抱；转向出口的动作切下层汇合。
rows.action: Claude主动搭肩；GPT保持托背、托膝，在顶部平台抱着她转向下行长阶，始终不放下。 Claude衣边焦损持续，脸出镜时苍白无羞红。
rows.entry: GPT已经将力竭的Claude抱稳，她仍清醒。
rows.exit: Claude安心靠近，GPT抱着她转向出口。
rows.effects: 衣袖轻擦，Claude呼吸渐平稳。

rows.title: 一同走出大殿
rows.framing: 退后广角背面群像／十二人离殿，教徒保持倒地
rows.camera: 背面广角随队伍缓慢后退扩大空间，保持十二人层次与两翼留守骑士区别；不穿过角色。
rows.transition: 用转身方向匹配切下层，省去下阶过程；脚步与空架火声渐远，再明确时间跳切街市。
rows.action: 省略下阶，GPT抱Claude已到下层中殿，与千问抱宝宝的队伍汇合，十二位核心角色沿通道离开；骑士留守。 Claude衣边焦损持续，脸出镜时苍白无羞红。
rows.entry: 省略下阶，GPT仍抱Claude，与下层同伴汇合。
rows.exit: 众人离开大殿，转入数日后的街市。 圣骑士留在教堂控制两翼与出入口，不随核心十二人加入街市结尾。
rows.cast_note: 十二核心角色离殿：GPT、Claude、DeepSeek、八位正门援军、Kimi；教主教徒倒地、骑士留守不混入离殿队形。
rows.effects: 脚步渐远，滴水和空刑架火声留在殿内，转街市前缓落。

rows.title: 数日后的长椅
rows.framing: 街边中远景／长椅同场景锚点
rows.camera: 明亮街边中远景沿长椅缓慢横移，清楚留下右侧空位，宝宝听到脚步转头时机位停住。
rows.transition: 夜殿离开后作明确数日后跳切，街声替代殿内声，不能当夜晚连续走到白天。
rows.action: 小鱼独坐，膝上捧着热饭，身边空位清楚可见；听到脚步，她向右看。
rows.entry: 数日后，伤后休养已过去；小鱼在明亮街市长椅上，饭碗重新出现。
rows.exit: 小鱼望向右侧来人，空位尚无人坐。
rows.cast_note: Claude脚步画外，长椅右侧空位仍无人。
rows.effects: 熟悉街市叫卖、碗勺轻响，不添加可辨新台词。
